job.title: Clinical Director of Obstetrics and Gynaecology
job.description:
Clinical Director of Obstetrics and Gynaecology Outback Queensland | Permanent, Full-time
Competitive remuneration package valued at up to $724,710 per annum
Lead women’s health. Shape the future in the heart of Outback Queensland.

A rewarding leadership opportunity is available for a Clinical Director of Obstetrics and Gynaecology to guide a multidisciplinary team and shape maternity and women’s health services across a vast regional and remote community.

You’ll champion clinical excellence, strengthen governance and help develop services that respond to local needs, including outreach and telehealth care.

A Leadership Role with Real Impact
  • Provide strategic, clinical and operational leadership across Obstetrics and Gynaecology.
  • Lead safe, evidence-based care and continuous service improvement.
  • Shape service planning and contemporary models of care for remote communities.
  • Support workforce planning, recruitment and retention.
  • Mentor registrars, junior doctors and future rural specialists.
  • Contribute to education, research and collaborative care.
The Location Enjoy a distinctive outback lifestyle with the services of a regional city and a strong community spirit. It’s a place to build genuine connections, enjoy a relaxed pace of life and explore rugged landscapes.

Lifestyle highlights include:
  • Fishing and outdoor recreation at the local lake.
  • Local sporting and community events, including the region’s celebrated rodeo.
  • Access to outback landscapes, national parks and rich cultural heritage.
  • Air connections to Brisbane, Townsville, Cairns and regional centres.
Remuneration and Benefits The competitive package is valued at up to $724,710 per annum, including a base salary of $225,305–$284,318, plus applicable incentives and allowances.

Benefits include:
  • 50% attraction and retention incentive allowance.
  • 15% regional and rural attraction allowance.
  • Motor vehicle and inaccessibility allowances.
  • Rent-free staff accommodation, subject to policy.
  • Five weeks’ annual leave and 3.6 weeks’ professional development leave.
  • 12.75% employer superannuation contribution.
  • Professional development allowance, salary packaging and eligible relocation expenses.
About You You’ll hold current general and specialist AHPRA registration and meet one of the following qualification pathways:
  • FRANZCOG, with subspecialty qualifications highly regarded; or
  • FACRRM, or FRACGP with FARGP, plus an Advanced Diploma of RANZCOG (Advanced DRANZCOG).
Ready to Shape the Future of Women’s Health?
Bring your leadership and clinical expertise to a role where you can develop a team, influence service delivery and improve access to care for women and families across Outback Queensland.
To explore this opportunity, send your current CV to Nicki or get in touch for a confidential discussion about the role and your next career move.

job.title: Clinical Director Senior Specialist Emergency Medicine
job.description:
Clinical Director – Senior Specialist Emergency Medicine Coastal Regional Queensland | Permanent, Full-time
Competitive remuneration package valued at up to $687,491 per annum

Are you an Emergency Medicine specialist ready to shape a service and lead a team?

A regional Queensland health service is seeking to appoint a Clinical Director of Emergency Medicine. This senior leadership opportunity combines clinical work with the chance to influence service direction, strengthen clinical governance and support the development of a committed emergency team.

The Role You’ll provide strategic, operational and professional leadership across the Emergency Department, with broad responsibility for quality, safety and service improvement.

You’ll lead the Department’s Senior Medical Officers, Visiting Medical Officers and Resident Medical Officers, working closely with two Deputy Directors focused on Clinical Governance and Workforce.

Supported by an experienced executive team and reporting to senior hospital and health service leaders, you’ll also contribute to wider initiatives to improve patient flow and access to inpatient beds.

What’s on Offer
  • A genuine leadership role with scope to influence emergency care and service development.
  • The opportunity to lead, mentor and support a diverse medical team.
  • Dedicated Deputy Director support across governance and workforce.
  • Involvement in organisation-wide work to improve patient flow and bed access.
  • A permanent, full-time appointment of 80 hours per fortnight, with flexible rostering.
  • A competitive remuneration package valued at up to $687,491 per annum.
The advertised salary range is $498,065–$612,252, with additional benefits including:
  • Employer superannuation of up to 12.75%.
  • Annual leave loading.
  • Professional development support.
  • Motor vehicle allowance.
  • Clinical managers allowance.
  • Salary packaging options.
Coastal Lifestyle Enjoy beautiful beaches, oceanfront living and year-round sunshine in a family-friendly regional Queensland community.
  • Affordable housing and significantly lower living costs than metropolitan cities.
  • Excellent public and private schools.
  • Modern cafés, restaurants, wineries and outstanding local produce.
  • Easy access to Brisbane, with direct flights available.
  • Less traffic and more time for life outside work.
  • Fishing, boating, diving, camping, surfing and national parks right on your doorstep.
This is a location where Emergency Physicians can build a sustainable long-term career while enjoying genuine lifestyle balance for themselves and their families.

Qualifications
Fellowship of the Australasian College for Emergency Medicine (FACEM) as recognised by the Australian Medical Council, including maintenance of CPD and good standing as required by AHPRA for the maintenance of Specialist Registration.

Apply or Find Out More For a confidential discussion or to submit your CV, please contact:

Nicki Wade
Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant | CC Medical
Phone: +61 401 010 048
Email: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au

job.title: Consultant / Specialist Nephrologist
job.description:
Consultant / Specialist Nephrologist South Australia | Ongoing Part-time | Multiple Positions
33.75 hours per week
Total Indicative Remuneration: $377,429–$848,152 per annum, pro rata
Build your nephrology career in a growing service and enjoy a lifestyle that makes room for more.

Multiple ongoing part-time opportunities are available for Consultant Nephrologists at a major acute hospital investing in the future of renal care.

You’ll care for a diverse, clinically complex patient group across inpatient, outpatient and dialysis settings, while contributing to the development of a growing renal service.

Working within a collaborative multidisciplinary team, you’ll have opportunities to contribute to service improvement, education and research, supported by the breadth of clinical practice offered by a major acute centre.

The Role
  • Deliver consultative and procedural renal care, including haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis.
  • Help develop supportive care pathways for patients with advanced kidney disease.
  • Contribute to regional dialysis service oversight and development.
  • Supervise and teach junior doctors and trainees.
  • Participate in quality improvement, clinical governance and service planning.
  • Develop research programs and support clinical trials.

A Lifestyle with Room to Breathe Enjoy a welcoming, liveable South Australian city with beautiful beaches, rolling hills and nature escapes close by.

Discover a celebrated food and wine scene, vibrant markets, festivals and sporting events, alongside the culture and convenience of city living. It’s an appealing setting to build your career while making time for family, recreation and life outside work.

About You
You’ll hold FRACP with advanced training in Nephrology, or an eligible equivalent specialist qualification, and be eligible for specialist registration with the Medical Board of Australia.
Experience in renal replacement therapy is essential, while an interest or expertise in glomerular disease is desirable.

Remuneration and Benefits
Total Indicative Remuneration: $377,429–$848,152 per annum, pro rata, including salary, superannuation, leave loading and applicable allowances.
Additional benefits include:
  • Ongoing part-time appointments, working 33.75 hours per week.
  • Salary packaging options.
  • Relocation assistance may be offered to eligible applicants.
  • Opportunities to contribute to service development, teaching and research.
Take the Next Step in Your Nephrology Career
Bring your expertise to a renal service with the ambition to grow.
Click “Apply” to submit your current CV, or contact Nicki for a confidential discussion about the opportunity.

Nicki Wade
Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant | CC Medical
Phone: +61 401 010 048
Email: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au

job.title: Emergency Registered Nurses
job.description:
Fancy earning up to $100 per hour as a ED Registered Nurse. We also have ABN rates available on selected contracts.
We currently have exciting opportunities across Alice Springs & Tennant Creek, as well as new roles in NSW, including Forbes. Some NSW roles offer allowances of over $1,100 per month, with no receipts required, subject to eligibility.
Most roles have ASAP or upcoming start dates, and contract lengths can be flexible. If you’d like a full list of our NSW ED roles, just reply to this email.
Our nurses enjoy the chance to:

🌏 Choose when and where they work, with time off between contracts.
✈️ Receive support with flights and accommodation on many contracts.
🏖️ Explore some of Australia’s most beautiful locations.
🤝 Make lifelong friends, gain new experiences and develop their clinical skills.

Holiday leave may be accommodated on longer contracts—just let me know what you need.

🏥 Tennant Creek, NT | Emergency Department
📅 ASAP start | Full-time | Up to 3 months (coverage for holiday period preferred)
💰 Up to $100 per hour + super, or up to $138 per hour ABN + super. 
Essential Qualifications:
  • Competent in Resus and ALS
  • At least 3 years ED Acute ED experience with understanding of Remote Context of the hospital
  • Competent in Non-Invasive Ventilation
  • Must be Competent in TRIAGE – please send triage certificate
🏥 Alice Springs, NT | Emergency Department
📅 14/12/2026 start to 17/01/2027 | Full-time | Up to 3 months
💰 Up to $100 per hour + super, or up to $138 per hour ABN + super. 
Essential Qualifications:
  • Resus
  • Triage
  • Ventilator Competent
  • Min 2 Years clinical experience in ED
PAYG Benefits
Up to $100 per hour for weekday shifts at RN8
• Weekend and shift penalties
• Superannuation paid in addition
• On-call allowance—10% of the applicable base rate
• In-charge allowance—up to $100 per shift
• Overtime while on call paid at 1.5 to 2 times the applicable shift rate


ABN contractor rates
• RN8+: $118 per hour, inclusive of GST and super
• Penalties paid in addition
• On-call allowance—10% of the applicable base rate
• In-charge allowance—$118 per shift
• Overtime while on call paid at 1.5 to 2 times the applicable shift rate


Travel, accommodation and expenses
✈️ Return flights to Alice Springs reimbursed up to $1000 & $2000 to Tenant Creek —claimable once every six months
🏠 Up to $616 per week toward accommodation and eligible expenses if you are not using onsite accommodation. If on-Site accommodation provided + $200 a week for expenses
🚗 Funds may also be used toward car hire, Uber and other eligible expenses
Accommodation currently averages approximately $316–$600 per week, potentially leaving around $100-$300 per week for other eligible expenses.


Eligible PAYG staff may also benefit from LAFHA tax savings through our payroll partner, GNA. Our average eligible employee receives approximately 16.6% more in take-home pay—often an additional $400–$500 or more per pay. Individual benefits will depend on personal circumstances and eligibility.

We have received excellent feedback from CC Medical nurses currently working in Northern Territory. The teams are welcoming and friendly, with plenty of social activities available.

Already committed to a contract? Refer a friend and receive $500!
Conditions apply: the person referred must not have previously worked for CC Medical, must not already be in discussions with us and must complete a contract of at least six weeks.

Message me for further information or to express your interest.
Cassandra Peacock – cassandrap@ccjobs.com.au – 0434 377 068

job.title: Director of Obstetrics and Gynaecology
job.description:
Director of Obstetrics and Gynaecology
Senior medical leadership | Tropical coastal Australia
Lead a service. Shape better care for women and families.
Salary package: $500k+

Are you an experienced Obstetrician and Gynaecologist ready to make a lasting impact?
This is a rare opportunity to lead the development of a comprehensive regional service and help shape the future of maternity and gynaecology care across a large and diverse community.

Make your home in a remarkable coastal region Enjoy a relaxed tropical lifestyle with beautiful beaches, rainforest, islands and outdoor adventures close at hand. This welcoming regional centre offers the convenience of city services alongside a more relaxed pace of life.

There’s plenty to enjoy beyond work, from exploring the Great Barrier Reef and nearby national parks to making the most of local cafés, restaurants, sporting clubs, festivals and community events. With quality schools and a family-friendly community, the region offers an appealing place to build both your career and your life.

The opportunity As Director, you’ll provide clinical and operational leadership across inpatient, outpatient, labour ward, emergency and operative services. You’ll champion safe, evidence-based, woman-centred care, strengthen clinical governance and support education, workforce development and service improvement.

Working alongside committed medical, midwifery, nursing and allied health teams, you’ll help build consistent care pathways, improve access and outcomes, and develop strong partnerships with tertiary referral services. Your leadership will influence how care is delivered across coastal, regional and rural communities.

A leadership role with genuine scope Join a progressive health service where collaboration, respect and innovation underpin the work. You’ll have the opportunity to:
  • Guide service development and clinical improvement
  • Support and develop a multidisciplinary workforce
  • Strengthen regional pathways and referral partnerships
  • Contribute to education, governance and quality initiatives
  • Make a visible difference to the health of women and families
What you’ll bring
  • FRANZCOG, or eligibility for specialist registration with the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA)
  • Strong clinical experience in Obstetrics and Gynaecology
  • Demonstrated leadership skills and a commitment to developing high-quality services
  • A collaborative approach to working with multidisciplinary teams and regional partners
Ready to take the next step?
If you’re ready to lead with purpose, shape the future of women’s healthcare and enjoy a tropical coastal lifestyle, we’d love to hear from you.
For a confidential discussion about this opportunity, please contact Nicki Wade, Senior Recruitment Consultant, on 0401 010 048 or email nickiw@ccjobs.com.au.

Apply now and discover where your next career move could take you.

job.title: Specialist/Consultant Obstetrician & Gynaecologist
job.description:
Specialist/Consultant Obstetrician & Gynaecologist 
Central Australia
Fixed term up to 24 months | Full-time or part-time
Specialist care with a lasting impact
Salary package: $400k+

A rewarding career in the heart of Australia
Discover an opportunity to practise specialist obstetrics and gynaecology in a regional centre where your expertise can have a direct and lasting impact.
You’ll join a busy teaching hospital caring for women and families across a vast Central Australian region. The service manages more than 700 births each year and combines hospital-based care with outreach to remote communities.

The breadth of work offers meaningful clinical variety, strong multidisciplinary connections and the opportunity to contribute to service development, education and improved health outcomes.

The hospital has established links with major tertiary and academic centres, supporting collaboration, teaching and research while providing opportunities to build your career in regional and remote healthcare.

A lifestyle shaped by wide-open spaces
Make your home in a welcoming, multicultural community surrounded by the dramatic landscapes of the Australian outback.
On your days off, explore mountain biking and hiking trails, camp beneath clear skies or visit some of the country’s most iconic natural destinations.

The town offers schools, sporting facilities, cafés and restaurants, with a close-knit community and a pace of life that makes it easier to connect with others and enjoy the outdoors.
For doctors seeking professional purpose, adventure and a different kind of work-life balance, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful contribution while experiencing a remarkable part of Australia.

Remuneration and benefits
The remuneration package is $249,959–$305,454, with access to additional allowances and benefits, including:
  • Professional Development Allowance of $22,251
  • Second Roster Allowance of $42,677
  • Private Practice Allowance (Option B)
  • Other allowances under the NTPS Medical Officer EBA
  • Salary packaging of up to $9,010, plus options for mortgage, rent and living expenses
  • 12% superannuation
  • Six weeks’ annual leave and 10 days’ professional development leave
  • Leave loading
  • Relocation and repatriation reimbursement of up to $10,000
About the hospital
The hospital is a 183-bed teaching hospital serving a catchment area of more than one million square kilometres.

Essential requirements
  • General and/or Specialist Registration with the Medical Board of Australia
  • FRANZCOG or an equivalent specialist qualification recognised in Australia
Apply now
If you’re interested in this opportunity, we would love to hear from you.

For a confidential discussion or to find out more, please contact Nicki Wade at CC Medical:
📞 0401 010 048
📧 nickiw@ccjobs.com.au

Alternatively, please apply with your current CV.
We look forward to helping you take the next step in your medical career.

job.title: Midwife / MGP Roles Across Northern Territory
job.description:
Fancy earning up to $102.50 per hour as a Core Midwife, or up to $150 per hour as an MGP Midwife? We also have ABN rates available on selected contracts.

We currently have exciting opportunities across Darwin, Alice Springs and Tennant Creek, as well as new roles in NSW, including Forbes. Some NSW roles offer allowances of over $1,100 per month, with no receipts required, subject to eligibility.
Most roles have ASAP or upcoming start dates, and contract lengths can be flexible. If you’d like a full list of our NSW midwifery roles, just reply to this email.
Our midwives enjoy the chance to:
  • 🌏 Choose when and where they work, with time off between contracts.
  • ✈️ Receive support with flights and accommodation on many contracts.
  • 🏖️ Explore some of Australia’s most beautiful locations.
  • 🤝 Make lifelong friends, gain new experiences and develop their clinical skills.
Holiday leave may be accommodated on longer contracts—just let me know what you need.

🏥 DARWIN, NT | Core Midwives & MGP Midwives
MGP contracts

Start date End date Duration
2 November 2026 4 January 202710 weeks
16 November 2026 8 February 2027 12 weeks
4 January 2027 29 March 2027 12 weeks
Extensions may be available, and leave can be accommodated.

💰 MGP: Up to $150 per hour base + super.
💰 Core Midwives: Up to $102.50 per hour PAYG or $118 per hour ABN. December and early January starts are available for approximately 6–12 weeks.

We’re also seeking expressions of interest for November, December, January and February across antenatal, postnatal and Birth Suite. There may be an opportunity to choose your primary area.

Travel and accommodation
  • Up to $1,200 return towards flights or petrol.
  • Up to $316 per week towards accommodation.
  • Up to $400 per week towards eligible out-of-pocket expenses.
  • Total support of up to $716 per week, subject to eligibility.
  • Offsite accommodation is available. There is also an onsite outdoor pool and access to a discounted gym membership.
🏥 TENNANT CREEK, NT | Midwife Clinical Specialist – Remote Outreach
📅 ASAP start | Full-time | Up to 3 months
💰 Up to $120 per hour + super, or up to $138 per hour ABN + super.

This is a rare opportunity for a midwife interested in remote outreach and working across the Barkly Region. It would suit someone with previous MGP experience; a background in Aboriginal health would be an advantage.
One of our MGP midwives is currently working in Tennant Creek and loves it so much that she has extended her stay!

What’s included:
  • Up to $300 per week towards eligible out-of-pocket expenses.
  • Up to $2,000 towards flights or petrol.
  • Accommodation provided, including private homes or onsite options.
  • Fleet car provided; a full, clean driver’s licence is required.
  • Extensive travel to remote health clinics throughout the Barkly Region.
This travel role has less on-call and after-hours support than some other outreach positions.

🏥 ALICE SPRINGS, NT | Midwife Clinical Specialist – Remote Outreach
📅 19 November 2026 – 8 January 2027 | Full-time
💰 Up to $120 per hour + super, or up to $138 per hour ABN + super.

Also seeking expressions of interest for January and February 2027: after-hours support roles at up to $102.50 per hour base or $118 per hour ABN.

What’s included:
  • On-call allowance of up to $12.81 per hour.
  • Overtime rates of time and a half or double time when called in, as applicable.
  • Up to $300 per week towards eligible out-of-pocket expenses.
  • Up to $1,000 towards flights or petrol.
  • Accommodation provided, including private homes or onsite options.
  • Fleet car provided; a full, clean driver’s licence is required.
What you’ll need:
  • Current knowledge of the National Immunisation Schedule and immunisation administration.
  • Experience with electronic health records.
  • Experience working in Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities.
  • Midwifery emergency care and neonatal resuscitation training updated within the past three years.
  • Current Basic Life Support.
  • Willingness to travel extensively across the Central Region, including by small plane or car, and stay in remote locations for short periods—for example, three nights.
Experience in remote health clinics and certified 4WD training are desirable, but 4WD certification is not mandatory.

💰 PAYROLL OPTIONS
CC Medical continues to offer our standard PAYG payroll. We can also discuss payment through Geoffrey Nathan, a specialist PAYG payroll provider.
Depending on your circumstances and eligibility, Living Away From Home Allowance arrangements may improve your take-home pay. Rates and tax outcomes vary, so we can provide further details for you to consider.
We also welcome midwives working under an ABN for eligible contracts.

🎁 REFER A MIDWIFE & RECEIVE $500–$840
Refer a midwife who is not already known to CC Medical, and receive a $500–$840 referral bonus when they complete a contract of six weeks or more. Conditions apply.

✅ INTERESTED?

job.title: Consultant/Specialist Obstetrician & Gynaecologist
job.description:
Consultant/Specialist Obstetrician & Gynaecologist
  • Multiple ongoing part-time opportunities
  • Total Indicative Remuneration: $377,429–$848,152 per annum, pro rata
  • Enjoy a relaxed, well-connected city lifestyle, with beaches, hills, food and cultural events close at hand
Build your career in a growing service and enjoy a lifestyle that makes room for more.
Join a busy and growing public maternity and gynaecology service. Multiple ongoing part-time opportunities are available for specialists who value high-quality care, collaborative practice and supporting the next generation of doctors.

A lifestyle with room to breathe
Make your home in a welcoming, liveable city where beautiful beaches, rolling hills and nature escapes are close by. Enjoy a relaxed pace, a celebrated food and wine scene, vibrant markets and a calendar filled with festivals and sporting events all without giving up the culture and convenience of city living.

The hospital offers the breadth of a major acute centre, a collaborative multidisciplinary team and opportunities to contribute to service development, education and research.

The opportunity
You’ll provide consultant-level obstetric and gynaecological care across inpatient, outpatient and on-call services, including complex and high-risk presentations. You’ll work closely with midwifery, neonatology and allied health teams, and contribute to clinical supervision, teaching, quality improvement and patient safety.

What you’ll bring
  • Experience managing high-risk obstetric and complex gynaecological cases in a public hospital setting.
  • A commitment to teaching and mentoring junior medical staff.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, including with culturally diverse communities.
  • The ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively in a demanding clinical environment.
Qualifications
  • Appropriate specialist qualifications in Obstetrics and Gynaecology, with eligibility for specialist registration.
  • RANZCOG assessment as substantially comparable or eligibility via the expedited pathway.
Remuneration
Total Indicative Remuneration: $377,429–$848,152 per annum, pro rata. This includes base salary, leave loading, superannuation and applicable allowances. Actual remuneration will depend on appointment details and applicable allowances.

Apply now
If you’re interested in a part-time consultant role where you can contribute to a busy service and support a collaborative team, we’d love to hear from you.
Apply with your current CV or contact Nicki Wade, Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant at CC Medical, for further information or a confidential discussion.

Phone: 0401 010 048
Email: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au

CC Medical (formerly known as Careers Connection) brings over 30 years of recruitment expertise.

job.title: Consultant / Specialist Geriatric Medicine
job.description:
Consultant / Specialist – Geriatric Medicine
Tasmania | Total Remuneration Package up to $500,000 + Relocation
Practice the medicine you trained for. Live the life you've been missing.
You can work as a Geriatrician almost anywhere.

Few places allow you to combine complex, rewarding medicine with genuine work-life balance quite like Tasmania.
At Tasmania's largest tertiary teaching hospital, you'll join a respected and collaborative Geriatric Medicine service where Comprehensive Geriatric Assessment remains at the heart of patient care not squeezed into impossible appointment times.

This is an opportunity to make a real difference while enjoying one of Australia's most liveable cities.

Why
Imagine finishing work and being only minutes from waterfront restaurants, mountain trails, wineries and world-class food.
It offers something increasingly rare:
  • A genuine work-life balance
  • Short commutes and little traffic
  • Affordable lifestyle compared with mainland capitals
  • Outstanding schools and family-friendly communities
  • Exceptional food, wine and cultural experiences
  • Easy access to beaches, hiking, sailing and national parks
Instead of spending hours commuting, you'll spend more time doing what matters most.

Why This Opportunity?
You'll join one of Australia's most established Geriatric Medicine departments based at Tasmania's major tertiary referral hospital and teaching centre.

You'll enjoy:
  • A highly supportive team of 18 Consultant Geriatricians
  • Strong Registrar, Resident and multidisciplinary support
  • Comprehensive Geriatric Assessment delivered the way it should be
  • Acute Geriatrics
  • GEM and subacute rehabilitation
  • Orthogeriatrics
  • Outpatient and consultative services
  • Opportunities to develop specialist interests
  • Active involvement with the University of Tasmania through teaching and research
  • The chance to help shape innovative models of care, including Older Persons Emergency services
This is a department with excellent retention because people enjoy working here.

The Position
As a Consultant/Staff Specialist Geriatrician you will:
  • Deliver specialist inpatient and outpatient Geriatric Medicine services
  • Provide consultative services across the hospital
  • Participate in Orthogeriatric and GEM programs
  • Supervise Registrars and junior medical staff
  • Contribute to education, research and quality improvement
  • Help develop future models of care for older Tasmanians
Flexible full-time and part-time appointments are available.

Exceptional Remuneration
Enjoy a highly competitive package including:
  • Total remuneration package up to $500,000
  • 35% Private Practice Allowance (or equivalent)
  • Annual CPD allowance of approximately $16,000
  • Motor vehicle allowance of approximately $28,000
  • Salary packaging benefits
  • Relocation assistance up to $25,000
  • Temporary accommodation assistance
  • Visa sponsorship available
  • Family relocation support
Who We're Looking For
We welcome applications from:
  • FRACP-qualified Consultant Geriatricians
  • Overseas-trained Specialists eligible for, or progressing through, the Specialist Pathway
  • Experienced Geriatricians seeking a collaborative, well-supported environment
  • Consultants looking for greater balance without compromising clinical complexity
Many of the specialists we place weren’t actively looking for a move they simply recognised an opportunity worth exploring.

How to apply
Whether you’re ready for a change or simply curious about what’s available, we’d be pleased to hear from you.
Apply with your current CV or contact Nicki Wade on 0401 010 048 or nickiw@ccjobs.com.au for a confidential discussion about the role, lifestyle and relocation assistance.

job.title: Consultant Psychiatrist | Forensic Mental Health
job.description:
Consultant Psychiatrist | Forensic Mental Health Melbourne, Victoria

Shape the future of forensic psychiatry through rewarding clinical practice, leadership and service development.
  • Employer visa sponsorship available — 482 or 186 visa
  • Relocation assistance of up to $10,000
  • Monday to Friday role with no routine weekend work
  • Flexible full-time, part-time and sessional appointments
Psychiatrists assessed as Substantially Comparable, on the Expedited Specialist Pathway (psychiatrists holding a UK CCT or Irish CSCST), or eligible for RANZCP assessment are encouraged to apply.

Help shape a growing service
Join a major Victorian forensic mental health service at a pivotal stage in its development. A significant expansion is planned, increasing inpatient capacity from 136 to 218 beds through six new units and 82 additional beds.

This is an opportunity to influence how care is delivered as the service grows, develop contemporary models of care and support multidisciplinary teams in a complex and rewarding area of psychiatry.

A varied and meaningful practice
Work across secure inpatient, prison and community settings, with opportunities to contribute to court and justice-related services.
You’ll collaborate with experienced colleagues across psychiatry, nursing, psychology, occupational therapy, social work, allied health and lived experience roles.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Providing specialist psychiatric assessment and treatment
  • Advising and supporting teams managing complex presentations and risk
  • Contributing clinical leadership and expertise in forensic mental health
  • Supervising registrars and junior medical staff
  • Supporting service development, education and training
  • Participating in quality improvement and research
Make the role your own
Balance clinical practice with supervision, leadership, teaching and academic interests. Flexible full-time, part-time, fractional and sessional appointments offer scope to find an arrangement that suits your professional goals.

About you
You’ll bring experience in general adult, forensic, acute or secure psychiatry, together with confidence in risk assessment and relevant mental health and forensic legislation.
A commitment to recovery-oriented, patient-centred care is essential, and an interest in teaching, supervision and service development will be valued.

Formal forensic psychiatry experience is welcome but not essential.

What’s on offer
  • EBA-based remuneration of $160.20–$221.19 per hour (HN16–HN59)
  • Employer visa sponsorship available through the 482 or 186 visa
  • Relocation assistance of up to $10,000
  • Monday to Friday work with no routine weekend commitments
  • Flexible appointment options
  • Consultant and leadership opportunities
  • Access to ongoing professional development
  • Opportunities to contribute to research and academic work
  • The chance to influence a major service expansion and develop your specialist forensic experience
Take the next step
Whether you’re an experienced forensic psychiatrist or looking to bring your broader psychiatry experience to this rewarding field, we’d be pleased to hear from you.
To express your interest, please apply with your current CV or contact Nicki Wade at CC Medical on 0401 010 048 or nickiw@ccjobs.com.au for a confidential discussion about the role and relocation opportunities.

job.title: Specialist/Consultant General Medicine
job.description:
Specialist/Consultant – General Medicine | Coastal Tasmania A rewarding general medicine role with a strong physician team, teaching opportunities and a distinctive Tasmanian lifestyle.

Salary package up to $500k PLUS

We’re seeking a Specialist in General Medicine to join a supportive medical team working across two regional hospitals, approximately 50 km apart. The service cares for a population of approximately 116,000 and provides acute and subacute general medicine services, alongside a broad range of medical subspecialties.

Live and work in Coastal Tasmania Enjoy a more connected regional lifestyle, with welcoming communities and easy access to Tasmania’s coastline, countryside and outdoor activities. Build lasting relationships with patients and colleagues while making a meaningful contribution to healthcare in the region.

You’ll work alongside physicians whose interests include cardiology, infectious diseases, gastroenterology and hepatology, respiratory medicine, nephrology, endocrinology and diabetes, geriatrics, and palliative care.

Both hospitals support advanced physician training in general medicine, and one is accredited for basic physician training. Peer review support is also available for overseas-trained physicians.

The opportunity The role includes providing general medical services within your clinical scope, contributing to patient care and service development, and supporting undergraduate medical education in partnership with the University of Tasmania’s Rural Clinical School.

This opportunity would suit a motivated specialist with recent acute hospital experience and a sound knowledge of contemporary general medicine.

The package
  • Fixed-term, full-time appointment of up to 76 hours per fortnight, with on-call duties
  • Start date by agreement; appointment through to 21 April 2029
  • Hours may be negotiated
  • $222,789–$319,701 per annum, pro rata, plus 12% superannuation
  • 20% retention allowance
  • Fully maintained private-plated vehicle or vehicle allowance of $30,254 per annum, pro rata
  • Private Practice Scheme participation at 35%, or an allowance in lieu
  • CPD allowance of $17,483 per annum, pro rata
  • Salary packaging, relocation and travel assistance, study leave, professional development support and Fitness Passport access
Senior Specialist Medical Practitioner rates are subject to meeting the relevant award criteria.

Eligibility Applicants should hold specialist registration, be an IMG on the specialist pathway, or hold a recognised overseas specialist qualification with sufficient experience in the specialty.

A current driver’s licence is required.

Apply now Bring your general medicine expertise to a supportive regional team and enjoy the professional opportunities and lifestyle Coastal Tasmania has to offer.
To express your interest, please apply with your current CV or contact Nicki Wade at CC Medical on 0401 010 048 or nickiw@ccjobs.com.au for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Locum Mental Health Clinician
job.description:
• 9th November – 31st January
  • Great feedback from other candidates
  • Large regional VIC city

 
The Hospital’s Mental Health Service offers a range of inpatient and community-based services for people with mental illness in the region.  They promote and provide a work environment that embraces professional development and supports staff to maximize growth through internal and external education. Our employees are the lifeblood of our organisation and we know that in order to provide exceptional care to our patients at all times, we need passionate, dynamic and committed employees to join us. 
 
This role is based in the Short-Term Assessment and Response Team (START), commencing 9 November 2026 to 31 January 2027 (a shorter timeframe may be considered).
 
The Short-Term Assessment and Response Team (START) supports triage, assessment, treatment, care and support for people of all ages who are experiencing crisis or acute mental illness or psychological distress. START supports access to the Area Mental Health and Wellbeing Service, as well as referral to other services or supports in the community.
 
 
To be successful in this role you will have a relevant degree in Social Work, Psychology or Occupational Therapy and relevant mental health experience.
 
Candidates will also have demonstrated experience, skill and / or knowledge in the provision of direct clinical care to people who have experienced mental illness along with a working knowledge of the relevant Mental Health Act. A current driver’s licence is essential.
 
 
  • FREE accommodation available – my current locums are in individual apartments
  • Domestic travel reimbursed
  • Locum rates dependent on experience, upto $75 per hour (negotiable) + super + option for living away from home tax benefits – $6-$7 per hour more!
  • ABN is an option
 
This major regional centre offers a vibrant culture filled with city sidewalk cafes and precincts of contemporary restaurants constantly surprise dedicated foodies with their innovative fare, fresh local produce. Enjoy local vineyards, a great climate and fun on the banks of the Murray River.

 
Working in regional Australia offers the chance to work within close knit communities. As part of smaller teams, you will access a wider range of patients and develop your clinical expertise. These roles offer great rates of pay, accommodation and the chance to broaden your skill set within a range of healthcare settings.
 


To apply for this role or to enquire about our other vacancies, please contact Rachael – Allied Health Division Lead at CC Medical on 0452 189 556 or email rachaeld@ccjobs.com.au




My contactable hours are Monday – Friday. If you need to contact me over the weekend, please send an email.

job.title: Consultant/Specialist Anaesthetist
job.description:
Consultant/Specialist Anaesthetist
Permanent full-time or part-time | Tropical coastal Queensland
Total remuneration is up to $520K
FANZCA or have been assessed by ANZCA as substantially comparable

Join an established anaesthesia department in a modern regional hospital, with a broad clinical scope, an active teaching role and a lifestyle shaped by sunshine, beaches and rainforest.

A coastal lifestyle
Set on Queensland’s east coast, this fast-growing regional centre offers a mix of coastal, rural and city living. Enjoy tropical summers, sunny skies for much of the year, island escapes, golden beaches, a blue river and a lush rainforest hinterland.
The region has a buoyant economy, a strong range of schools and education providers, and a less congested pace than a capital city. Brisbane is around an hour away by air.

The opportunity
You’ll provide high-quality anaesthesia services and work closely with the Clinical Director and multidisciplinary team. The department supports orthopaedic, trauma, general, gynaecological, obstetric, paediatric, ENT, dental, ECT and endoscopic procedures, as well as a pre-assessment clinic, acute pain service and obstetric epidural service. The team also supports trauma and cardiac arrest responses.

The service has seven operating theatres, 14 recovery bays and a pre-theatre holding area. As an accredited training facility, it supports ANZCA and JCCA trainees, along with junior medical staff. You’ll contribute to teaching, patient safety, audit, research and service planning.

Remuneration and benefits
Total remuneration is up to $520K, with benefits including:
  • 12.75% employer superannuation
  • Professional Development Allowance of $21,500 per year and 3.6 weeks’ Professional Development Leave
  • Motor vehicle allowance
  • Overtime and on-call allowances
  • Salary sacrificing and paid parental leave, subject to conditions
  • Attraction and Retention Incentive Allowance for eligible private practice arrangements
  • Leave loading, Employee Assistance Program and access to Fitness Passport
About you
You’ll hold FANZCA or have been assessed by ANZCA as substantially comparable. You’ll bring recent experience across a broad range of anaesthesia, including emergency and paediatric cases, and the ability to contribute to a collaborative team and support high-quality patient care.

Interested in your next career move?
Combine rewarding clinical work with a tropical coastal lifestyle. We’d welcome the opportunity to discuss how this role could align with your career goals.
To apply, please send your CV to nickiw@ccjobs.com.au. For further information or a confidential discussion, contact Nicki Wade on 0401 010 048.

job.title: Specialist / Senior Specialist Gastroenterology
job.description:
Specialist / Senior Specialist – Gastroenterology
Coastal Queensland | Permanent part-time | 60 hours per fortnight
Salary: $6,416–$8,133 per fortnight
FRACP essential

Build a rewarding specialist career where tropical beaches, rainforest adventures and relaxed coastal living are part of everyday life.

An opportunity is available for a Gastroenterologist to join a contemporary regional referral hospital within an expanding health service. Work alongside a supportive physician team, with specialist nursing and registrar support, while enjoying the flexibility of a permanent part-time appointment.

Make the most of life outside work
Swap the metropolitan rush for a vibrant coastal community offering beautiful beaches, lush rainforest and wide-open spaces. Spend your weekends exploring the coast, enjoying local cafés and restaurants, or taking part in sporting clubs, festivals and the arts.

With quality schools, excellent community facilities and a culturally diverse population, the region offers an appealing setting for families and doctors seeking a change of pace. Choose a coastal or country lifestyle while maintaining a fulfilling specialist career.

The role

Deliver specialist inpatient and outpatient care across gastrointestinal and hepatobiliary disorders, with a particular focus on clinic-based management of inflammatory bowel disease.

Your work will include:
  • Regular upper and lower gastrointestinal endoscopy lists.
  • Specialist consultations and multidisciplinary management.
  • Contributions to acute medical care and elective outpatient services.
  • Teaching and supervision of physician trainees and medical students.
  • Clinical governance, audit, quality improvement and service development.

A supportive clinical environment
Join a multidisciplinary team of 18 FTE physicians across a broad range of medical subspecialties. The department supports RACP-accredited Basic Physician Training and Advanced Training in General Medicine.
You will also have access to cardiology services providing 24/7 primary PCI, alongside specialist-led Emergency Medicine and Intensive Care teams.

Contribute your expertise within a supportive department, with opportunities to participate in teaching, collaborative care and service development.

About you
You must hold Fellowship of the Royal Australasian College of Physicians (FRACP) and bring specialist gastroenterology expertise, proficiency in upper and lower gastrointestinal endoscopy, and a commitment to patient-centred care, collaborative practice and teaching.

Take the next step
Ready to combine a fulfilling specialist role with an appealing coastal lifestyle?

Contact Nicki Wade for a confidential discussion or to express your interest.
Email: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au
Phone: 0401 010 048

job.title: Consultant Psychiatrist - Forensic
job.description:
What’s on offer 
  • $350,000 - $550,000 p.a. + relocation allowance
  • Collaborative, supportive team environment
  • Access to flexible working arrangements and leave benefits
  • Sunny climate, beautiful beaches and relaxed outdoor lifestyle
About the role

In this role, you will deliver specialised psychiatric care across a diverse range of forensic settings, including hospital, community services, correctional facilities, consultation-liaison and court services. Drawing on your specialist expertise, you will assess and manage complex mental health needs, provide tailored treatment and support recovery, helping to achieve positive outcomes for individuals with diverse and often complex needs.

Working closely with multidisciplinary teams and key stakeholders, you will provide clinical leadership and develop evidence-based treatment plans that support safe, coordinated and person-centred care. You will also contribute to service development and continuous improvement, sharing your clinical knowledge and expertise to strengthen team capability and enhance the quality of forensic mental health services.

job.title: Locum Social Worker – Mental Health
job.description:
• ASAP start for six months + possible extension
  • Establish a new mental health service
  • Locum rates + FREE accommodation available

 
Experienced Mental Health Social Worker required for locum based in regional Victoria. The minimum commitment required is six months ++. There is also a permanent role available.

 
The role will involve establishing a new service and framework. The mental health is currently outsourced, however this will be an internal service. Join my current Social Worker who has just extended her contract.

 
The service have a mental health drop-in clinic.  You will work with the Hospital Outreach Mental Health team as well as other community organisations.  Cases include general counselling to more complex mental health issues, through to assisting people negotiate Medicare, visas, government departments, housing etc. 

 
Community Mental Health experience is essential, as well as experience working with CALD and indigenous communities and experience in rural health. You will join a team of approximately 20 Health Staff including Nurses, Midwife, Speech Pathology, Occupational Therapy, Physiotherapy, Health Promotion, Allied Health Assistants, Podiatrists & Dietitians.
 
 
  • FREE accommodation available + locum rates $$. I’ve had great feedback from previous locums!
  • Travel reimbursement also available.
  • Locum rates upto $80 per hour + super + option for living away from home tax benefits ($6/7 dollars per hour more). ABN also available.

 
 
Please only respond if you have relevant paid experience and have been assessed by the AASW OR qualified in Australia.

job.title: Community Speech Pathologist
job.description:
• 12 month maternity leave contract
  • Adult and paediatric caseload
  • Grade 2 rates + travel + accommodation available

 
Experienced Speech Pathologist required for this regional Victorian service. They operate under the Multi-Purpose Service (MPS) Model providing flexible and coordinated services such as Acute, Aged Care and Allied Health Services to it's wider community. Open to Grade 2 clinicians and experienced Grade 1 candidates. One other Speech Pathologist on the team.


This specialist role is responsible for the provision of comprehensive community based Speech Pathology services across the location and surrounding areas. The caseload is complex and covers a diverse population.


You will provide assessment and intervention across a varied caseload including, speech, language, literacy, stuttering, voice and swallowing. While predominantly paediatrics focused, you will have the opportunity to work with adult clients within the community as well as in aged care and sub-acute care. This is an excellent opportunity to develop clinical experience in rural health care, while working closely with other speech pathologists, allied health assistants and health care professionals to provide holistic, evidence based care. 


You will work alongside a team of other allied health professionals on the team including OT, Physiotherapist, Exercise Physiologist, Podiatrist, Dietitian, Qualified Social Worker, Health Promotion Officer and Allied Health Assistants.

 
FREE accommodation available + travel assistance. Grade 2 salary + leave entitlements. This is a fixed term contract, not a locum position. I’ve had great feedback from previous candidates!

 
To apply for this role or to enquire about our other vacancies, please contact Rachael – Allied Health Division Lead at CC Medical on 0452 189 556 or email rachaeld@ccjobs.com.au

job.title: Hospital Social Worker – locum or permanent
job.description:
• 23rd November for 8 weeks
  • Flights covered + FREE accommodation
  • Locum rates upto $75 per hour + super

Experienced Social Worker required for this NT service. This is a remote 60 bed hospital. The service requires high level skills and demonstrated cultural competence working respectfully with Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander population. There is a high incidence of domestic and family violence, child neglect and abuse reporting and statutory child removal. 
 
 
There are two options:
 
Locum
  • An 8 week locum + possible extension commence on 23rd November
  • Flights covered upto $1200 + FREE accommodation
  • Locum rates upto $75 per hour + super
 
 
Permanent
  • Position: P2 (increment can be negotiated pending experience) Ongoing/Permanent
  • Annual salary: $95,697-$114,104 + superannuation
  • Hours: 36.45 per week – shift work and weekends included
  • Start date: ASAP
  • Up to $12,000 in relocation support in accordance with the Allied Health Relocation Support Guideline
  • 12-weeks accommodation provided. Following this period, subsidised staff accommodation rates will apply, subject to availability. Studio unit (on campus): approximately $340 per fortnight, Shared unit/house (off campus): approximately $400 per fortnight, One-bedroom unit (on campus): approximately $400 per fortnight
 
 
To be considered, you will have:
 
  • Relevant qualifications in Social Work that meets membership eligibility requirements of the Australian Association of Social Workers.  
  • Experience in acute hospitals, including emergency department and general medicine wards
  • Experience in contemporary DFSV intervention, risk assessment and safety planning in regional and remote context. 
  • Proven ability to independently plan and prioritise a high-volume complex workload within an ever changing work environment. 
  • Ability to work extended hours, including weekends and after-hours shifts, on call (penalty rates apply)
  • This role is NOT suitable for new graduates or candidates who don't have PAID hospital experience
 
 
Cases include:
  • Sexual violence
  • ED presentations
  • Crisis response (adults and paediatrics)
  • Guardianship
  • Advocacy
  • NDIS applications
  • Inpatients only – ED, acute wards – general medical, surgical, palliative care, rehabilitation, maternity and paediatrics
  • You must have strong crisis response and experience with victims of domestic and sexual violence
  • Join a team of clinicians at different levels from Director, Team leaders, SWs, DTs, OTs, PTs, SPs, AHAs, ALOs, Admin 

You must have relevant experience.

This role requires you to be eligible for AASW membership

Overseas trained Social Workers, please do not respond unless your qualifications have been assessed by the AASW

Join my other locums who love this remote health service!

 
Come to where the Outback meets the tropics and discover a region full of gorges and misty waterfalls, thermal springs and ancient cultures. This region is a nature lovers paradise.

job.title: Registered Nurse - Skin Cancer Nurse
job.description:
Skin Cancer Nurse (Registered Nurse)

Role Overview

Want to be part of a big national program that screens people for skin cancer at work? We're looking for nurses to join our team in cities like Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, and more. You can work on a casual or contract basis, and we have jobs in both cities and rural areas. As a skin cancer nurse, you'll assess people's skin and moles, use special tools for a closer look, and figure out if anyone needs to see a doctor. You'll also keep track of everything in our records. It's a excellent way to help people stay healthy and catch any problems early.

Skills & Experience
  • Current AHPRA Registered Nurse registration
  • Experience in skin cancer screening, skin checks or mole checks
  • Strong clinical assessment and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage onsite screening sessions
  • Skin cancer/dermoscopy qualifications 
  • Mole mapping/melanography experience and own dermoscope advantageous

  • National, with potential regional and rural opportunities

job.title: Registered Nurse - Remote Primary Health Contracts
job.description:
Remote Primary Health Contracts - N4 & N5 Rural & Remote Nursing


The Opportunity

Take on a rewarding Remote Area Nurse (RAN) role delivering comprehensive primary health care and population health services to Indigenous communities across remote Australia. RANs work collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams and, in many locations, practise autonomously without a Doctor onsite, managing presentations independently while responding to emergency and on-call situations within the community.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Primary health care and emergency response
  • Acute and chronic disease management
  • Child and adult immunisations
  • Child and sexual health
  • Well-person screening
  • Maternity emergency care
  • Patient assessment, treatment planning, and health education
  • Clinical documentation and care coordination
  • On Call emergency Situations
These remote clinics rely heavily on experienced RANs and Nurse Unit Managers to assess, stabilise, manage, and refer patients appropriately in line with remote healthcare protocols and CARPA guidelines.

Essential Requirements: 
  • Current AHPRA Registered Nurse (Division 1)
  • Full Australian working rights
  • Recent Remote Area Nursing or remote Primary Health Care experience in Australia
  • Strong knowledge of CARPA guidelines is essential
  • Ability to work autonomously in isolated communities
  • Confidence managing emergencies and acute presentations
  • Experience working alongside Aboriginal Health Practitioners
  • Willing to travel interstate
  • Current manual driver licence
Essential Certifications & Training
  • Remote Emergency Care (REC) Certificate – CRANAplus or equivalent
  • Midwifery Emergency Care (MEC) Certificate – CRANAplus or equivalent
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) / Advanced Life Support (ALS) – Current certification required
  • Immunisation Provider Certificate – Including Understanding Vaccines and the National Immunisation Program
  • 4WD Manual Off-Road Driving Certificate – Experience and certification in manual 4WD remote/off-road driving 
  • Ability to meet NT Health compliance requirements
Benefits & Perks
  • Competitive rates of $102 – $118 per hour + super (depending on experience)
  • Additional on-call allowances where applicable
  • Travel and accommodation provided for eligible contracts
  • Flexible engagement options: ABN, PAYG, or salary packaging partner option-  - tax savings of $500+ weekly
  • Weekly allowance provided of $175 towards (out of pocket T & C apply)
  • Flexibility to choose contracts that suit your lifestyle and availability
About us

CC Medical is a boutique medical recruitment agency with 30+ years’ experience partnering with leading remote health providers to connect experienced Remote Area Nurses with autonomous, clinically diverse contracts across some of Australia’s most rewarding and professionally challenging settings. These opportunities are suited to nurses who thrive in autonomous practice, are confident managing emergency presentations prior to retrieval, and are passionate about delivering culturally safe, community-led primary healthcare in remote Australia.
 
Referral reward

Introduce a Remote Area Nurse and receive a $750 bonus from us once eligibility conditions are met (T&Cs apply). Refer a Friend | Healthcare Professionals | CC Medical

  • General acute inpatients including neurology, general medical, orthopaedics, surgical and rehab, ED and ICU
  • Full time hours, Monday – Friday
  • FREE accommodation available – my current locums are in individual apartments
  • Domestic travel reimbursed
  • Locum rates dependent on experience, upto $75 per hour + super + option for living away from home tax benefits – $6-$7 per hour more!
  • Upto $90 ABN per hour
  • October – February – flexible duration based on your availability
  • I’ve had great feedback from current locums. Many choose to stay on or return to the service
  • Australian hospital ward experience is mandatory
 
This major regional centre offers a vibrant culture filled with city sidewalk cafes and precincts of contemporary restaurants constantly surprise dedicated foodies with their innovative fare, fresh local produce. Enjoy local vineyards, a great climate and fun on the banks of the Murray River.

 
Working in regional Australia offers the chance to work within close knit communities. As part of smaller teams, you will access a wider range of patients and develop your clinical expertise. These roles offer great rates of pay, accommodation and the chance to broaden your skill set within a range of healthcare settings.

job.title: Consultant Emergency Medicine
job.description:
Consultant Emergency Medicine Leadership opportunities | Coastal Western Australia
Remuneration package: $424,525–$539,140 per annum
Additional Head of Department allowance: $19,174 per annum, where applicable

Build your specialist career by the coast, with opportunities to lead, teach and shape a regional Emergency Medicine service.

CC Medical is seeking Consultant Emergency Physicians to join an established regional referral hospital in Western Australia’s Midwest. Opportunities are available to undertake Head of Department responsibilities or pursue a Director of Emergency Medicine Training pathway.

Permanent, fixed-term, full-time, part-time and sessional appointments are available, with flexible working arrangements and fractional FTE encouraged.
The opportunity Join a busy Emergency Department delivering specialist care across a diverse range of acute, trauma and critical care presentations. You will lead clinical decision-making, support junior doctors and assist surrounding regional hospitals through telehealth and retrieval coordination.

Recent infrastructure investment includes a contemporary, purpose-built Emergency Department, a new Intensive Care Unit and a Mental Health Inpatient Unit. Emergency facilities include:
  • Four resuscitation bays.
  • Fast Track and Ambulatory Care areas.
  • A Short Stay Unit.
  • Low-stimulus observation facilities.
  • Dedicated procedure and plaster rooms.

Work alongside an experienced multidisciplinary team, supported by 24/7 senior medical presence, within an ACEM, RACGP and ACRRM accredited training environment.
Leadership and professional development Make a meaningful contribution to clinical education, workforce development and service improvement.

Experienced consultants can influence departmental direction through Head of Department duties, while clinicians with a strong interest in teaching may be considered for a Director of Emergency Medicine Training pathway.
Enjoy coastal living Finish your shift by the beach and spend your weekends exploring the coastline, boating, fishing or enjoying spectacular sunsets over the Indian Ocean.

This vibrant regional city combines beautiful beaches, waterfront cafés and restaurants with the convenience of a regional centre. Enjoy a welcoming community and a relaxed outdoor lifestyle, with plenty of opportunities to explore Western Australia’s coast and outback.

Benefits
  • Annual remuneration package of $424,525–$539,140.
  • Additional Head of Department allowance of $19,174 per annum, where applicable.
  • Sessional remuneration of $817.44–$1,038.13 per session.
  • Regional incentives, relocation support and accommodation assistance.
  • Flexible working arrangements, including part-time and fractional FTE.
  • Four weeks’ annual leave plus three weeks’ professional development leave.
  • Five weeks’ overseas professional development leave after five years.
  • Opportunities in leadership, education and service development.

About you You will hold FACEM or an equivalent specialist qualification, with unrestricted specialist registration in Emergency Medicine with the Medical Board of Australia.

You will also bring:
  • Senior Emergency Medicine experience within Australian healthcare settings.
  • Strong resuscitation and procedural skills.
  • Confidence managing complex presentations where subspecialty support may be limited.
  • Sound clinical judgement and a collaborative approach to leadership.
  • A commitment to teaching, mentoring and high-quality patient care.

Experience in rural emergency medicine, retrieval medicine, critical care or regional referral services will be highly regarded.

Find out more Ready to explore your next career move?

Contact Nicki Wade for a confidential discussion.

Nicki Wade
Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant
Phone: +61 401 010 048
Email: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au

CC Medical — over 30 years of recruitment expertise, formerly known as Careers Connection.

job.title: Locum Podiatrist/Senior Podiatrist
job.description:
• ASAP start for three months ++ (shorter term by negotiation)
  • Outpatients, high risk feet, complex wound care
  • Locum rates & FREE accommodation + travel

 
Experienced Podiatrists required for role with regional health service, located approximately four hours from Adelaide. You’ll join a medium size allied health team. The role is to start ASAP for three months ++ in duration.
 
There are several vacancies across two locations. Open to AHP 1, 2 or 3 level options.
 
 
Your caseload will cover:
  • Rural generalist caseload. Caseload is predominately outpatients, but includes some inpatients, aged care and paediatrics. May be opportunities for outreach to rural/ remote communities. Caseload would be allocated as per experience.
  • You will be will be proficient in high risk wound care (with 30-40 active high-risk wound patients at the site) but would be working in a rural generalist role servicing clients across the age spectrum and across clinical priorities and programs.
  • Regional/ rural experience preferred - working with Aboriginal consumers, high risk wound experience.
  • Join a multi-disciplinary team including OT, PT, SP, SW, O&P, DT. The Podiatrists work closely with Diabetes Educators, Orthotics & Prosthetics and Wound Nurse. The Podiatry department will soon consistent of 3 contractor/ FIFO staff.
  • You will be working in the local community. A car is provided for work purposes. The role will be Monday – Friday, 37.5 hours per week.
  • Free accommodation provided
  • Upto $500 reimbursed for travel (with receipts)
  • Competitive locum rates in line with experience – PAYG + option for living away from home tax benefits or ABN (up to $100 per hour)
 
I’ve placed many locums with this service over the years and the feedback is positive. The team are young and inclusive.
 
 
Located on Eyre Peninsula’s Spencer Gulf in South Australia, this region is an important hub and the region’s biggest city for retail shopping. The location boasts a warm climate, accessible ocean shores and saltwater fishing. It represents South Australia’s foremost combination of industrial and nature-based experiences. With vivid scenery, small city charm, distinctive mystic outback landscapes and year-round things to do.
 


To apply for this role or to enquire about our other vacancies, please contact Rachael – Allied Health Division Lead at CC Medical on 0452 189 556 or email rachaeld@ccjobs.com.au

 
My contactable days are Monday – Friday. If you need to contact me over the weekend, please send an email.

job.title: Registered Nurse - Skin Cancer Nurse
job.description:
Skin Cancer Nurse (Registered Nurse)

Role Overview

Want to be part of a big national program that screens people for skin cancer at work? We're looking for nurses to join our team in cities like Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, and more. You can work on a casual or contract basis, and we have jobs in both cities and rural areas. As a skin cancer nurse, you'll assess people's skin and moles, use special tools for a closer look, and figure out if anyone needs to see a doctor. You'll also keep track of everything in our records. It's a excellent way to help people stay healthy and catch any problems early.

Skills & Experience
  • Current AHPRA Registered Nurse registration
  • Experience in skin cancer screening, skin checks or mole checks
  • Strong clinical assessment and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage onsite screening sessions
  • Skin cancer/dermoscopy qualifications highly desirable
  • Mole mapping/melanography experience and own dermoscope advantageous
Benefits & Perks
  • Flexible casual & contract opportunities
  • Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications
  • National, regional and rural opportunities
  • Travel and other allowances where applicable
  • Training provided on relevant systems and processes
  • Ongoing opportunities within a growing national program
Referral reward

Introduce a Skin Cancer Nurse and receive a $750 incentive from us once eligibility conditions are met (T&Cs apply). Refer a Colleague | Healthcare Professionals

We are a boutique Healthcare recruitment agency with 30+ years’ experience connecting healthcare professionals to meaningful roles across Australia.

Coastal, Regional Victoria
Permanent full-time | 76 hours per fortnight
Salary package up to $450k+
IMGs – assessed as substantially comparable or eligible via expedited pathway will be considered.

An excellent opportunity is available for a Consultant Psychiatrist to join a supportive and expanding Adult Mental Health and Wellbeing Service in one of regional Victoria’s most attractive coastal locations.

An exceptional coastal lifestyle
Located along Victoria’s spectacular south-west coast, the region offers the ideal combination of professional opportunity, affordability and work-life balance.

You can enjoy:
  • Beautiful beaches and dramatic coastal scenery
  • Easy access to the Great Ocean Road and nearby historic seaside villages
  • Surfing, swimming, fishing, kayaking, scuba diving and boating
  • Excellent public and private schools
  • A welcoming, family-friendly community
  • A thriving café, restaurant, arts and cultural scene
  • Music, food and community festivals throughout the year
  • Affordable housing compared with metropolitan areas
  • Shorter commutes and more time to enjoy life outside work
  • Convenient road and rail connections to Melbourne
Whether you are looking to raise a family, enjoy an active coastal lifestyle or escape the congestion and cost of a major city, this region offers an enviable place to live and work.

The opportunity
Working across community and inpatient services, you will provide high-quality psychiatric assessment and treatment to adults and older people experiencing a broad range of mental health conditions.
You will provide clinical leadership and governance to a multidisciplinary case-management team, helping consumers navigate a coordinated and recovery-focused journey through the service.

The clinical component of the position is predominant, with additional opportunities to contribute to education, leadership and the continuing development of regional mental health services.
This is an exciting time to join the service, with the Adult/Older Persons Mental Health Unit undergoing a significant $10.9 million redevelopment to provide modern facilities for consumers and staff.

To be considered, you will have:
  • Fellowship of the Royal Australian and New Zealand College of Psychiatrists, or an equivalent specialist qualification – IMGs eligible via expedited pathway or assessed as substantially comparable.
  • Current CPD compliance
  • Experience in Older Persons Psychiatry across inpatient and community services
  • Strong multidisciplinary teamwork, communication and time-management skills
  • Ability to supervise and work collaboratively with other clinicians
  • Competence using electronic medical records
Advanced training in Adult or Old Age Psychiatry is desirable but not essential.

Benefits
The successful applicant will receive:
  • An attractive specialist remuneration package
  • Permanent full-time employment
  • Salary packaging for meals and entertainment
  • Novated leasing and additional superannuation contribution options
  • Internal and external professional development opportunities
  • Ongoing clinical supervision and peer support
  • Leadership, resilience and mentoring programs
  • Opportunities to contribute to service development, education and research
  • Excellent employment terms and conditions
Join a progressive regional mental health service where your expertise, leadership and contribution will be genuinely valued.

Ready to make your next career move?
If you’re looking for a rewarding specialist role and an exceptional coastal lifestyle, we’d love to hear from you.

job.title: Senior Specialist / Specialist - General Medicine Physician and Geriatrician
job.description:
Senior Specialist / Specialist - General Medicine Physician and Geriatrician
Coastal Regional Queensland
Permanent full-time | 80 hours per fortnight
Total remuneration package up to $564,548 per annum

Advance your career and make coastal Queensland home
Are you a dual-trained General Medicine Physician and Geriatrician looking for a senior role offering clinical variety, leadership opportunities and a lifestyle that leaves time for living?
A major regional referral hospital in coastal Queensland is seeking an experienced specialist to join its collaborative Department of Medicine. This permanent appointment combines a broad and rewarding clinical scope with excellent remuneration, private practice potential and an enviable coastal lifestyle.

A lifestyle worth relocating for
Imagine finishing work and being only a short drive from uncrowded beaches, coastal walking tracks and waterways ideal for swimming, boating and fishing.
This beautiful part of Queensland offers a warm, sunny climate and a relaxed pace of life, with the space and affordability to enjoy it. Whether your ideal weekend involves exploring the Southern Great Barrier Reef, camping in a national park, surfing, dining on fresh local produce or simply spending time outdoors with family, the region makes work–life balance feel achievable.

You can enjoy:
  • Beautiful beaches and year-round outdoor living
  • Easy access to the Southern Great Barrier Reef
  • Boating, fishing, swimming, surfing and camping
  • National parks, coastal trails and abundant wildlife
  • Quality schools and family-friendly communities
  • Excellent shopping, dining, sporting and cultural facilities
  • More affordable housing than Queensland’s major cities
  • Shorter commutes and less congestion
  • Convenient road and air connections to Brisbane
  • A welcoming community where specialists are genuinely valued
This is an opportunity to build a rewarding specialist career while enjoying more space, less pressure and a lifestyle many people only experience on holiday.

The opportunity
You will provide high-quality specialist care to patients with complex general medical and geriatric needs across:
  • Acute and subacute inpatient services
  • Ambulatory and outpatient care
  • Community-based programs
  • Virtual models of care
  • Multidisciplinary clinical services
The position is pivotal in developing contemporary models of care for frail older people. You will provide senior clinical leadership, contribute to clinical governance and service improvement, and support the education and supervision of junior medical staff.

You will join a welcoming multidisciplinary team where your expertise in both General Medicine and Geriatrics will be highly valued—and where you can make a visible difference to patients, services and the wider community.

Private practice potential
The successful candidate may also have the opportunity to establish a private practice outside their public appointment, with potential assistance including:
  • Access to sessional consulting rooms
  • Credentialling and administrative support
  • Introductions to local GPs, physicians and surgeons
  • Assistance establishing local referral pathways
Exceptional remuneration and benefits
The total remuneration package is valued at up to $564,548 per annum, including:
  • Base salary of $223,136–$282,912 per annum
  • Employer superannuation contributions of up to 12.75%
  • General Attraction and Retention Allowance
  • Regional and Rural Attraction Allowance
  • Motor Vehicle Allowance
  • Professional Development Allowance
  • Paid Professional Development Leave
  • Annual leave loading of 17.5%
  • Salary-packaging options
  • Flexible working arrangements
The hospital
This established regional referral hospital provides an extensive range of acute, specialist and community healthcare services to a large and growing population.
The Department of Medicine offers a diverse clinical environment supported by committed multidisciplinary teams and strong links across inpatient, outpatient and community services. You will have genuine scope to influence service development, introduce contemporary models of care and improve outcomes for older people across the region.

Essential requirements
Applicants must hold, or be eligible to obtain:
  • Specialist registration with AHPRA
  • Fellowship of the Royal Australasian College of Physicians, or recognised equivalent specialist qualifications
  • Specialist qualifications and experience in General Medicine and Geriatric Medicine
Ready to make your move?
If you are an experienced General Medicine Physician and Geriatrician looking for a senior specialist opportunity in a supportive regional environment, we would love to hear from you.
To express your interest, please provide your current CV, details of your specialist registration and Fellowship/qualifications, and your anticipated availability.

For a confidential discussion about the role please contact:

Nicki Wade
Senior Recruitment Consultant – Permanent Doctors
CC Medical
P: +61 401 010 048
E:nickiw@ccjobs.com.au
