job.title: Specialist Medical Oncologist | Leading Regional Victoria Cancer Service
job.description:
Specialist Medical Oncologist | Leading Regional Victoria Cancer Service
Coastal living - Gateway to world-class nature, surf beaches, and whale watching
Build your oncology career in a growing specialist referral centre while enjoying an outstanding coastal lifestyle.

An exciting opportunity is available for a Specialist Medical Oncologist to join an established multidisciplinary cancer service within a major regional health network.
You will work alongside experienced Medical Oncologists and Haematologists, delivering comprehensive cancer care to patients from a broad regional catchment.

An Exceptional Coastal Lifestyle
Enjoy the benefits of living in a vibrant regional centre offering:
  • Spectacular beaches, national parks and coastal walking trails
  • Excellent schools, healthcare, shopping and family amenities
  • Affordable housing compared with metropolitan centres
  • A thriving café, restaurant, sporting and cultural scene
  • Strong road networks
  • Convenient access to airports and major metropolitan centres
  • A relaxed coastal lifestyle without professional isolation or city congestion
Why Consider This Opportunity?
  • Established and expanding regional cancer service
  • Varied inpatient, outpatient and emergency oncology caseload
  • Collaborative multidisciplinary team environment
  • Opportunities to contribute to service development and clinical trials
  • Strong teaching partnership with a leading university medical school
  • Flexible employment arrangements may be considered
  • Attractive specialist remuneration or an agreed VMO contract
The Role
You will:
  • Provide specialist inpatient and outpatient oncology care
  • Participate in oncology and haematology on-call services
  • Contribute to multidisciplinary cancer meetings
  • Supervise Registrars and junior medical staff
  • Support quality improvement, clinical governance and risk-management activities
  • Participate in medical student and postgraduate teaching
  • Pursue relevant research and clinical trial opportunities
An Exceptional Coastal Lifestyle
Enjoy the benefits of living in a vibrant regional centre surrounded by:
  • Spectacular beaches and coastal walking trails
  • National parks, wineries and renowned regional produce
  • Excellent schools and family-friendly amenities
  • Affordable housing compared with metropolitan areas
  • A thriving café, restaurant, sporting and cultural scene
  • A relaxed lifestyle with space, convenience and a strong sense of community
About You
You will have:
  • Fellowship of the Royal Australasian College of Physicians in Medical Oncology, or recognised equivalent
  • Specialist registration, or eligibility for specialist registration, with AHPRA
  • Broad medical oncology experience suited to regional practice
  • A commitment to evidence-based care, clinical quality and patient safety
  • Strong communication, collaboration and teaching skills
Take the Next Step
Advance your specialist career within a respected regional cancer service where you can make a meaningful contribution to patient care, service development, teaching and research—all while enjoying an exceptional coastal lifestyle.

How to Apply
For a confidential discussion or further information about this opportunity, please contact:

Nicki Wade
Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant
CC Medical
Email: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au
Phone: +61 401 010 048

job.title: Locum Hospital Social Worker
job.description:
• 28th September – 16th October
  • Flights covered + FREE accommodation
  • Locum rates upto $75 per hour + super

Experienced Social Worker required for this NT service. This is a remote 60 bed hospital. The service requires high level skills as a sole Social Worker and demonstrated cultural competence working respectfully with Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander population. There is a high incidence of domestic and family violence, child neglect and abuse reporting and statutory child removal. 

You must be available from 28th September – 16th October – the dates are not flexible.
 
 
 
I’ve had great feedback from the 40+ allied health locums I’ve placed here over the years. To be considered, you must have:
  • Experience NOT including placements providing clinical social work services within a hospital setting (Emergency Department), including crisis intervention and short term support
  • Strong knowledge and experience in domestic and family violence risk assessment, safety planning and support services
  • Experience working with child protection concerns, including mandatory reporting requirements, and liaising with relevant agencies
  • Ability to work extended hours, including weekends and after-hours shifts, on call (penalty rates apply)
  • This role is NOT suitable for new graduates or candidates who don't have PAID hospital experience
 
Cases include:
  • Sexual violence
  • ED presentations
  • Crisis response (adults and paediatrics)
  • Guardianship
  • Advocacy
  • NDIS applications
  • Inpatients only – ED, acute wards – general medical, surgical, palliative care, rehabilitation, maternity and paediatrics
  • You must have strong crisis response and experience with victims of domestic and sexual violence
  • Join a team of clinicians at different levels from Director, Team leaders, SWs, DTs, OTs, PTs, SPs, AHAs, ALOs, Admin 



You must have relevant experience.
This role requires you to be eligible for AASW membership
Overseas trained Social Workers, please do not respond unless your qualifications have been assessed by the AASW
 
Join my other locums who love this remote health service!
 
Return flights reimbursed (upto $1200) and free accommodation for locums. A driving license is required for this role.
 
Locum rates up to $75 per hour + super dependent on experience. Potential for living away from home benefits (more take home pay, usually $5-6 dollars more an hour!).
 
Come to where the Outback meets the tropics and discover a region full of gorges and misty waterfalls, thermal springs and ancient cultures. This region is a nature lovers paradise.
 
 
To apply for this role or to enquire about our other vacancies, please contact Rachael – Allied Health Division Lead at CC Medical on 0452 189 556 or email rachaeld@ccjobs.com.au


My contactable days are Monday – Friday. If you need to contact me over the weekend, please send an email.

job.title: Consultant Anaesthetist | Tropical Queensland
job.description:
Consultant Anaesthetist | Tropical Queensland
Major Tertiary Referral Hospital | Package Up to $546,915

Advance your career within a major tertiary referral hospital offering an exceptional breadth of complex anaesthetic practice, outstanding professional benefits and an enviable tropical lifestyle.

You will join a large, supportive anaesthetic department delivering more than 16,000 procedures annually across 14 operating theatres. The position offers extensive clinical variety, excellent professional development opportunities and the chance to contribute to a respected tertiary service.

A well-connected domestic airport provides regular direct flights to major Australian cities, making travel home, professional conferences and weekend escapes easy.

The Opportunity
You will provide high-quality anaesthetic care across a diverse range of complex elective and emergency services, including:
  • Cardiac, thoracic and vascular surgery
  • Neurosurgery and neuroradiology
  • Paediatrics and tertiary obstetrics
  • Trauma and emergency surgery
  • Complex general, ENT, urology and plastic surgery
  • Acute pain and perioperative medicine
You will also contribute to registrar supervision, clinical teaching, governance, research, quality improvement and service development.

An Exceptional Tropical Lifestyle
Enjoy year-round warmth, affordable housing and minimal congestion, with beaches, tropical islands, national parks and the Great Barrier Reef within easy reach.
This is an outstanding opportunity to enjoy complex tertiary practice and career development without the cost and congestion of a capital city.

Benefits
  • Remuneration package up to $546,915 per annum
  • 50% attraction and retention allowance
  • 5% regional attraction allowance
  • Motor vehicle allowance of $21,000–$25,500
  • Professional development allowance of $21,500
  • 3.6 weeks of professional development leave
  • Four to six weeks of annual leave
  • 12.75% employer superannuation
  • Salary packaging benefits
  • Potential relocation assistance
About You
To be considered, you will hold:
  • FANZCA or an international specialist qualification assessed as substantially comparable by ANZCA
  • Specialist registration with AHPRA or eligibility to obtain registration
  • Broad experience in complex elective and emergency anaesthesia
  • A commitment to collaborative practice, teaching and clinical excellence
Take the Next Step
Build your specialist career within a leading tertiary hospital while enjoying everything Tropical Queensland has to offer.

Apply today or contact:

Nicki Wade
Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant
CC Medical
Email: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au
Phone: +61 401 010 048

job.title: Consultant Psychiatrists - Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities
job.description:
What’s on offer
  • Salary package of $400,000 – $550,000 p.a. plus relocation support
  • Be part of Queensland’s expanding IDD mental health services
  • Multiple positions across highly sought-after Queensland locations
  • Strong clinical leadership opportunities
  • Collaborative multidisciplinary teams
  • Generous leave, salary packaging and professional development
  • An enviable Queensland lifestyle, with beaches, hinterland, dining and cultural experiences on your doorstep
There’s never been a better time to build your future in Queensland
 
Queensland Health is investing $51.5 million over four years to expand specialist mental health services for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities. The program includes a statewide Centre of Excellence and 12 new multidisciplinary consultation-liaison teams, which will provide specialist assessment, treatment advice and support to improve mental health outcomes for people with intellectual disability. This statewide expansion is increasing demand for Australian and international psychiatrists whose principal area of expertise is intellectual and developmental disability psychiatry.
 
About the roles
 
These specialist roles involve the assessment and management of mental illness in people with intellectual and/or neurodevelopmental disabilities, including those with complex needs and challenging behaviours. Working within experienced multidisciplinary teams, you will provide expert psychiatric care, support individuals, families and carers, and contribute to clinical leadership and service development.
 
This is an opportunity to help shape the future of specialist IDD mental health services across Queensland while making a meaningful difference to the lives of people with disability.
 
About Queensland
 
Queensland offers more than a career - it offers an exceptional lifestyle. Enjoy a warm, sub-tropical climate, world-class beaches, spectacular natural landscapes, vibrant cities and welcoming regional communities. From Brisbane and the Gold Coast to the Sunshine Coast and regional Queensland, you can build a rewarding career while enjoying the space, sunshine and freedom that make Queensland one of Australia’s most desirable places to live. With excellent schools, thriving communities, diverse dining and entertainment, and endless opportunities to explore the outdoors, Queensland makes it easy to enjoy a fulfilling life both at work and beyond.

Relocating to Australia… support we can offer you
  • Forget Government Job Boards - We know our hospitals. We provide you with exclusive Psychiatrist job vacancies and direct link-ups with Mental Health Dept. Directors
  • Our recruitment service is FREE and personalised to your career and location requirements
  • Psychiatrist Peer to Peer Group Support with the RANZCP Specialist Assessment and Medical Board Applications
  • All Job applications prepared and submitted by our recruitment team.
  • Support with enrolling your children into leading private or state-run schools
  • Registered Migration Agent advice and support
Sound like you

Contact Jonathan Richards, your Psychiatry Recruitment Specialist, to find out more about these roles and all they have to offer.
 
Tel: 0422408729
 
Email: jonathanr@ccjobs.com.au

About Jonathan Richards

“I have 15+ years’ experience connecting Psychiatrists with the best job opportunities across Australia. It is my passion and privilege to ensure you are being provided with the best recruitment services available.”

Specialist Endocrinologist | Coastal Victoria | Package up to $440,000
Live Where Others Holiday
Are you a Consultant Endocrinologist seeking a rewarding specialist position combining clinical excellence, academic opportunities and an exceptional coastal lifestyle?
A leading regional health service is seeking a Specialist Endocrinologist to join its growing medical team in one of Victoria’s most desirable coastal regions.

As the major specialist referral centre for a large regional catchment, the service provides comprehensive acute, subacute, specialist, community, mental health and aged-care services.
This is an exciting opportunity to help expand and shape regional endocrinology services while enjoying an outstanding work–life balance.

Why Make the Move?
Imagine finishing work just minutes from:
  • Stunning beaches and coastal walking trails
  • Seasonal southern right whale migrations
  • Award-winning restaurants, wineries and cafés
  • Excellent public and private schools
  • More affordable housing than metropolitan centres
  • A vibrant arts, cultural and sporting community
  • Easy access to Melbourne and the iconic Great Ocean Road
Enjoy a fulfilling specialist career without the congestion and long commutes of city living.

The Opportunity

  • Deliver high-quality, evidence-based and patient-centred care
  • Collaborate with medical, nursing and allied health professionals
  • Participate in clinical governance, audits and quality improvement initiatives
  • Contribute to the development of clinical guidelines and contemporary models of care
  • Teach and mentor medical students, junior doctors and allied health professionals

job.title: Director of Medical Service/DMS
job.description:
Director of Medical Services | Coastal NSW | Executive Leadership
A career with purpose. A coastal lifestyle worth living.
Salary package up to $400k plus DMS managerial allowance

Are you an energetic and collaborative medical leader ready to influence the future of healthcare?
An outstanding opportunity is available for a Director of Medical Services to provide strategic leadership across a major regional hospital and its surrounding health services. Located in one of coastal New South Wales’ most attractive lifestyle regions, this role combines genuine executive influence with an enviable balance of beaches, waterways, national parks and welcoming communities.

Coastal Living Without Losing City Connections
Enjoy the space, affordability and natural beauty of coastal living while remaining well connected to major metropolitan centres.
The region is positioned along the Pacific Highway and North Coast rail corridor, providing convenient access to:
  • Newcastle – approximately two hours by road
  • Sydney – approximately 3.5 hours by road
  • Regular NSW TrainLink services connecting the region with Newcastle, Sydney and destinations along the North Coast
  • A nearby regional airport offering direct services to Sydney and Brisbane, with onward connections throughout Australia and internationally
  • Easy access to larger coastal centres for additional shopping, education, healthcare and entertainment
Professionally, you will also remain connected through strong partnerships with a leading university, a major medical research institute and a network of 11 experienced Directors of Medical Services across one of New South Wales’ largest health organisations.

The Lifestyle
Enjoy an exceptional coastal lifestyle without giving up professional challenge or career progression.
The region offers:
  • Pristine beaches and picturesque waterways
  • National parks, rainforests and scenic hinterland
  • Boating, fishing, surfing, cycling and bushwalking
  • A thriving local food, arts and sporting culture
  • Affordable housing and a relaxed, family-friendly community
  • Quality schools and essential services
  • Convenient access to major regional centres and Sydney
  • Domestic flight connections within easy reach
It is an ideal location for medical professionals seeking space, community and a healthier pace of life while remaining connected to larger cities.
This is a pivotal time to join the organisation, with a $100 million hospital redevelopment progressing towards its next stage. You will have a rare opportunity to help shape future clinical services, strengthen the medical workforce and contribute to healthcare planning that will benefit the community for generations.

The Opportunity
Working closely with the General Manager, Director of Nursing and broader executive team, you will provide leadership and professional oversight across medical services and the medical workforce.
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Providing strategic and operational leadership across medical services
  • Supporting medical workforce planning, recruitment, credentialing and performance
  • Influencing the future direction and delivery of clinical services
  • Promoting clinical governance, patient safety and continuous improvement
  • Building a positive, accountable and inclusive workplace culture
  • Supporting medical leaders and empowering teams to deliver outstanding care
  • Contributing to the planning and implementation of the hospital redevelopment
  • Collaborating with an experienced network of medical administration executives across the wider health service
This is an opportunity to move beyond day-to-day administration and make a lasting contribution to the direction, culture and capability of an important regional healthcare service.

About You
You will be a respected and forward-thinking medical leader who brings energy, sound judgement and a collaborative approach to executive decision-making.
You will ideally demonstrate:
  • Appropriate medical registration with AHPRA
  • Significant experience in medical leadership, administration or management
  • Strong knowledge of clinical governance, workforce planning and quality improvement
  • The ability to lead organisational change and engage diverse stakeholders
  • A commitment to safe, patient-centred and high-quality healthcare
  • An inclusive leadership style that values and empowers people
  • Excellent communication, negotiation and relationship-management skills
The Hospital
You will join a significant regional referral hospital providing an extensive range of acute, emergency, surgical, medical and community-based services.
Backed by a substantial redevelopment program, the hospital is entering an exciting period of growth and transformation. The investment will support contemporary facilities, enhanced clinical capability and improved access to care for communities across the region.

The broader health organisation is one of the largest public health services in New South Wales, supporting more than 900,000 people and maintaining strong links with leading university and medical research institutions.

Benefits
  • Influential executive medical leadership position
  • Opportunity to shape a major hospital redevelopment
  • Supportive and experienced senior leadership network
  • Relocation and settlement assistance for you and your family
  • Salary packaging benefits
  • Fitness Passport
  • Employee Assistance Program for employees and family members
  • Strong academic and medical research connections
  • Permanent and flexible employment arrangements may be considered
Take the Next Step
If you are ready to lead meaningful change and build your career in one of coastal New South Wales’ most appealing regions apply now.

job.title: Clinical Director of Medicine | Senior Medical Leadership | Coastal Regional NSW
job.description:
Clinical Director of Medicine | Senior Medical Leadership | Coastal Regional NSW
Lead, innovate and shape the future of a major Department of Medicine—just 30 minutes from a thriving coastal city and its beaches.
  • FRACP is an essential requirement
  • Approximately 50% clinical and 50% leadership
  • Contemporary, purpose-built regional hospital
  • Broad departmental leadership across multiple physician specialties
  • Attractive coastal-regional lifestyle with excellent transport connections
  • Relocation and onboarding assistance available
An outstanding opportunity is available for an accomplished Physician to provide strategic, clinical and operational leadership to a large and diverse Department of Medicine within a modern regional health service.

An Exceptional Regional Lifestyle
Enjoy the space, affordability and sense of community offered by regional living without sacrificing convenient access to city amenities.
The hospital is positioned approximately 30 minutes from a thriving coastal city, beautiful beaches and an established regional airport. Major road and rail connections provide convenient access to other key centres across New South Wales.

The surrounding region is renowned for its wineries, restaurants, national parks, quality schools and welcoming family-friendly communities.
This is an ideal opportunity for a senior Physician seeking genuine leadership influence, modern clinical facilities and an enviable balance between career and lifestyle.

This influential role offers the scope to shape medical services, lead service redesign, strengthen physician education and training, and develop contemporary models of care across the department.
Approximately 50% of the position remains clinically focused, enabling you to maintain meaningful involvement in frontline patient care while leading departmental strategy, clinical governance, workforce development and service performance.

The Department
You will provide leadership across a comprehensive range of medical services, including:
Leadership across General Medicine, Cardiology, Oncology, Palliative Care, Gastroenterology, Nephrology, Endocrinology, Respiratory Medicine, Infectious Diseases, Hospital in the Home and Virtual Care

Working closely with senior hospital executives, clinical leaders and district-wide stakeholders, you will help develop sustainable, patient-centred services that respond to the evolving needs of the regional community.

The Opportunity
As Clinical Director of Medicine, you will:
  • Provide strategic, clinical and operational leadership across the Department of Medicine
  • Lead service planning, redesign and performance improvement initiatives
  • Oversee clinical governance, quality, safety and risk management
  • Guide medical workforce planning, recruitment, wellbeing and professional development
  • Strengthen physician education, supervision and training accreditation
  • Champion contemporary models of care, including Medical Assessment Units, rapid-access clinics, Hospital in the Home and virtual care
  • Support research and education through established university and medical research partnerships
  • Build productive relationships across specialties, services and external organisations
  • Represent the department at hospital and health-service leadership forums
  • Maintain an active clinical practice within General Medicine or your recognised physician subspecialty
About You
You will be an experienced, collaborative and forward-thinking medical leader with the credibility and vision to bring people together, lead change and deliver sustainable improvements.
To be considered, you must hold:
  • Fellowship of the Royal Australasian College of Physicians—FRACP
  • Specialist registration with AHPRA
  • Senior clinical experience in General Medicine or a relevant physician subspecialty
You will also bring:
  • Demonstrated leadership experience in clinical governance, workforce management, service development or performance improvement
  • Experience leading change and improving clinical systems
  • A strong interest in physician education, supervision, training and accreditation
  • Highly developed communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills
  • A commitment to safe, evidence-based and patient-centred care
  • The ability to inspire teams and build a positive, accountable departmental culture
Why Consider This Opportunity?
  • Senior leadership impact: Shape the future direction of a major Department of Medicine
  • Balanced portfolio: Approximately 50% clinical and 50% leadership responsibilities
  • Modern working environment: Join a contemporary, purpose-built hospital
  • Broad clinical scope: Lead General Medicine and an extensive range of physician subspecialties
  • Service innovation: Influence new and emerging models of hospital and community-based care
  • Education and training: Strengthen the department’s profile as a highly regarded physician training destination
  • Academic connections: Collaborate with established university and medical research partners
  • Professional development: Access leadership, education and research opportunities
  • Relocation support: Receive dedicated assistance with recruitment, onboarding and settling into the community
  • Employee benefits: Access salary packaging, professional development support, wellbeing programs and discounted fitness facilities
Apply Now
If you are an experienced Physician ready to take the next step in senior medical leadership, we would welcome the opportunity to speak with you.

job.title: Senior Specialist / Specialist – Interventional Cardiology
job.description:
Senior Specialist / Specialist – Interventional Cardiology
Regional Queensland | Establish a New Interventional Cardiology Service | Package Up to $564,939
Build a Service. Shape a Region. Advance Your Career.

An exceptional opportunity is available for an experienced Interventional Cardiologist to take a leading role in establishing and developing a new interventional cardiology service within a major regional referral hospital in Queensland.

Following significant investment in its cardiac services, the hospital now features a state-of-the-art Cardiac Hybrid Theatre, purpose-built Cardiac Catheterisation Laboratory, expanded Cardiac Investigations Unit and dedicated 12-bed Cardiology Ward.

This is more than a procedural position. You will have the opportunity to establish clinical pathways, influence models of care, develop regional capability and help shape the future of specialist cardiac services across an extensive referral network.

The Opportunity
As a Senior Specialist or Specialist in Interventional Cardiology, you will deliver high-quality General and Interventional Cardiology services across the Coronary Care Unit, Cardiology Ward, outpatient clinics and Cardiac Catheterisation Laboratory.

You will play a central role in establishing the hospital’s new interventional cardiology service while contributing to clinical leadership, education, governance and future service development.

Key responsibilities will include:
  • Delivering comprehensive General and Interventional Cardiology services
  • Undertaking contemporary interventional procedures, including PCI
  • Participating in the development and delivery of primary PCI services
  • Establishing models of care, clinical pathways, protocols and referral processes
  • Providing clinical leadership in patient safety, clinical governance and quality improvement
  • Supporting the development of cardiac capability across the regional referral network
  • Supervising and teaching registrars, junior medical officers and Cardiac Catheterisation Laboratory staff
  • Contributing to multidisciplinary education, research and professional development
  • Helping guide the future expansion of specialist cardiac services
The Hospital
This major regional referral hospital provides an extensive range of specialist, acute and emergency services to communities across a large geographical area.
The expanding cardiac service is supported by a growing multidisciplinary team of Cardiologists, Cardiac Physiologists, nurses, junior medical officers, allied health professionals and administrative staff.
The Cardiac Investigations Unit provides a comprehensive range of diagnostic services, including:

  • Transthoracic and transoesophageal echocardiography
  • Exercise and dobutamine stress echocardiography
  • Exercise stress testing
  • Tilt-table testing
  • Ambulatory ECG monitoring
  • Ambulatory blood pressure monitoring
With its newly developed interventional capability and purpose-built facilities, the hospital is entering an exciting period of clinical growth and establishing itself as a regional centre of excellence for cardiac care.

About You
We are seeking a collaborative and forward-thinking Specialist Cardiologist who offers:
  • Specialist qualifications in Cardiology
  • Eligibility for specialist registration with AHPRA
  • Fellowship-trained or equivalent contemporary experience in Interventional Cardiology
  • Current PCI procedural experience
  • Experience participating in primary PCI services
  • Strong General Cardiology capability
  • A commitment to clinical governance, patient safety and service improvement

  • Strong communication, teaching and multidisciplinary collaboration skills
Internationally trained specialists who have been assessed as substantially comparable, or who may be eligible for an appropriate specialist registration pathway, are encouraged to enquire.

Remuneration and Benefits

The total remuneration package is valued at up to $564,939 per annum and may include:
  • 12.75% employer superannuation
  • 17.5% annual leave loading
  • 3.6 weeks of professional development leave

  • Motor vehicle allowance
  • Overtime, recall and on-call allowances, where applicable
  • Attraction and retention incentives
  • Granted private practice arrangements, where applicable
  • Teaching, research and academic appointment opportunities
  • Relocation and immigration assistance for eligible applicants
An Attractive Regional Queensland Lifestyle
Enjoy the professional scope of a major referral hospital while benefiting from the space, convenience and relaxed pace of regional Queensland.
The region offers established schools, university facilities, shopping, dining, sporting amenities and welcoming communities. Housing is more attainable than in many capital cities, commutes are shorter, and spectacular beaches, islands and national parks are within easy reach.

Victoria–NSW Border | Flexible FTE | Package Up to $400,000+
Direct daily flights to Melbourne and Sydney

Are you a psychiatrist seeking meaningful clinical work, genuine career progression and a better work–life balance?

Whether your interests lie in acute inpatient psychiatry, community mental health, older persons’ services or child and adolescent psychiatry, opportunities are available to align with your expertise.

Your responsibilities may include:

  • Supervising Registrars, Fellows and Junior Medical Officers
  • Teaching medical students through the University of Melbourne
  • Participating in clinical governance, quality improvement and service development

Remuneration

job.title: Consultant/Specialist – Emergency Medicine
job.description:
Consultant/Specialist – Emergency Medicine
Package Up to $647,306 | Coastal Lifestyle | Flexible Rostering
An exceptional opportunity is available for Emergency Medicine Specialists seeking an attractive remuneration package, genuine flexibility and a relaxed coastal lifestyle in one of Australia’s most naturally beautiful regions.

Permanent full-time and part-time appointments are available within a supportive Emergency Medicine service offering varied clinical exposure, excellent teaching opportunities and the freedom to develop your professional interests.

A Lifestyle Worth Relocating For
Imagine finishing your shift and being only minutes from uncrowded beaches, pristine wilderness, mountain-bike trails, fishing, kayaking and exceptional local food and produce.
The region offers affordable housing, short commutes, welcoming communities and the space to enjoy more time with family. Regional air and sea connections provide convenient access to mainland Australia, including direct flights to a major capital city in under an hour.

This is a rare opportunity to combine a rewarding specialist career with the lifestyle and flexibility many doctors spend years trying to achieve

The Opportunity
You will work within a well-established regional service operating across two Emergency Departments and supporting a population of approximately 116,000.
The departments collectively manage around 60,000 presentations annually, with the principal hospital serving as the regional trauma centre. Clinical services include:
  • Intensive care
  • General medicine and surgery
  • Orthopaedics
  • Paediatrics
  • Obstetrics and gynaecology
  • Mental health
  • Acute stroke telemedicine
  • 24-hour pathology and on-call radiology
Shape a Career Around Your Interests
You will join a small and inclusive specialist team with experience across toxicology, point-of-care ultrasound, paediatric emergency medicine, disaster and humanitarian medicine, clinical research, palliative care, medical education and administration.

Specialists are encouraged to develop individual portfolios aligned with their skills and interests while contributing to clinical governance, teaching, supervision and service development.
The department offers accredited Emergency Medicine training and provides opportunities to supervise ACEM, RACGP and ACRRM trainees and participate in education and outreach programs supporting more remote communities.

Remuneration and Benefits
  • Total remuneration package up to $647,306
  • 12% employer superannuation
  • 20% Regional Recruitment and Retention Allowance
  • 35% private practice scheme participation or allowance in lieu
  • Fully maintained private-plated vehicle or motor vehicle allowance of $28,786
  • Continuing Professional Development allowance of $17,483
  • Generous salary packaging benefits
  • Relocation and travel assistance
  • Study leave and professional development support
  • Comprehensive leave entitlements
  • Flexible full-time and part-time appointments
  • Exceptionally flexible rostering arrangements
Eligibility
Applications are welcomed from:
  • Fellows of the Australasian College for Emergency Medicine
  • Internationally trained Emergency Medicine Specialists who have completed an ACEM specialist assessment – substantially comparable ONLY.
How to Apply?
If you are an experienced Emergency Medicine Specialist seeking a rewarding position with genuine flexibility, outstanding professional opportunities and an exceptional coastal lifestyle, we would welcome the opportunity to speak with you.

To express your interest, please select Apply Now and submit your current CV. For a confidential discussion or further information about the position, please contact:

Nicki Wade
Senior Recruitment Consultant – Permanent Doctors
CC Medical
Phone: +61 401 010 048
Email: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au

All applications and enquiries will be handled in the strictest confidence.

job.title: Clinical Lead Obstetrics & Gynaecology
job.description:
Clinical Lead – Obstetrics & Gynaecology
Senior Leadership Opportunity | Package up to $671K + 12% Super | Exceptional Work-Life Balance
Are you an experienced Consultant/Specialist Obstetrician & Gynaecologist ready to take the next step into clinical leadership while maintaining a rewarding hands-on practice?
We are recruiting for an outstanding Clinical Lead – Obstetrics & Gynaecology opportunity with a well-established regional health service in Tasmania.

A Different Kind of Lifestyle
Imagine finishing work without the long commute, having the coast, mountains and wilderness on your doorstep, and being able to enjoy a lifestyle that can be increasingly difficult to achieve in Australia's major cities.

Tasmania offers an enviable combination of coastal living, spectacular natural surroundings, excellent local produce, welcoming communities and affordable housing, while still providing the opportunity to develop a highly rewarding specialist career.

Whether your weekends involve beaches, hiking, mountain biking, fishing, wineries, farmers' markets or simply having more time with family, this is an opportunity to achieve genuine balance without compromising your career.

Offering a remuneration package up to $671,153 p.a. + 12% superannuation, this is an exceptional opportunity to combine senior clinical practice, strategic leadership, teaching and service development while enjoying the lifestyle benefits for which Tasmania is renowned.

The Opportunity
Working alongside the Clinical Director – Women’s & Children’s Services, you will provide clinical and strategic leadership across Obstetrics and Gynaecology while continuing to deliver specialist care.
You will have the opportunity to influence the future direction of the service, support workforce and service development, mentor junior doctors and trainees, and contribute to undergraduate and postgraduate medical education.

The established O&G service offers:
  • Approximately 1,000 births annually
  • Level 4 maternity service
  • Level 4 neonatal service
  • 8-bed Intensive Care Unit
  • Experienced midwifery workforce and highly regarded Midwifery Group Practice
  • Established antenatal and gynaecology services
  • Gynaecological surgery including laparoscopy and colposcopy
  • RANZCOG-accredited training positions, including FRANZCOG core trainees
  • Advanced Proceduralist trainees
  • Strong teaching and continuing professional development culture
  • Close links with the University of Tasmania Rural Clinical School
  • Approximately 1:5 after-hours on-call roster
This is an excellent opportunity for a Consultant who enjoys broad Obstetrics and Gynaecology and wants the autonomy and professional satisfaction of helping shape a regional women's health service.

Exceptional Remuneration & Benefits
Depending on eligibility and appointment level, additional benefits include:
  • 20% regional Recruitment & Retention Allowance
  • 35% allowance in lieu of private practice
  • Fully maintained private-plated motor vehicle or $30,254 p.a. vehicle allowance
  • Generous relocation assistance
  • Accommodation assistance available
  • Salary packaging benefits
  • Professional development support and study leave
  • Generous leave entitlements
  • Access to subsidised fitness facilities for you and your family
Who We're Looking For
We would particularly like to hear from experienced Obstetricians & Gynaecologists with:
  • Specialist qualifications in Obstetrics & Gynaecology
  • Broad contemporary O&G experience
  • Strong communication and multidisciplinary team skills
  • An interest in clinical leadership, education and service development
  • Specialist registration with Ahpra, or eligibility to obtain appropriate Australian medical registration
Applications from suitably qualified international specialists considering relocation to Australia are welcomed, including UK, Irish and other internationally trained Consultant Obstetricians & Gynaecologists who may be eligible for an Australian specialist registration pathway.

Fixed-term appointment – up to three years | Full-time, with hours potentially negotiable

Interested in exploring the opportunity?
Apply now with your current CV or contact Nicki Wade for a friendly and confidential discussion about the position and the relocation support available.

Nicki Wade
Senior Recruitment Consultant – Permanent Doctors
CC Medical
Phone: +61 401 010 048
Email: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au

All enquiries and applications will be treated in the strictest confidence.

job.title: Clinical Director – Geriatric, Rehabilitation & Palliative Care Medicine
job.description:
Clinical Director – Geriatric, Rehabilitation & Palliative Care Medicine
Regional Victoria | Major Regional Health Service | Easy Access to Melbourne
Permanent Full-Time | Medical Leadership Opportunity
Relocation Support Available | Excellent Remuneration
Salary package up to $450K

Are you an experienced Medical Specialist ready to take the next step into a high-impact clinical leadership role, without giving up your own clinical practice?
This is an exceptional opportunity to join one of Victoria’s leading regional health services, providing strategic and clinical leadership across Geriatric Medicine, Rehabilitation Medicine and Palliative Care, while maintaining up to 50% clinical practice within your own specialty.

Why This Opportunity Stands Out
This is regional medicine without feeling remote.
You’ll join a large, progressive health service employing approximately 5,000 staff, servicing a regional population of more than 320,000 people and providing an extensive range of acute, subacute, specialist and community services.

The hospital offers the scale, clinical complexity and professional opportunities of a major health service, combined with the lifestyle advantages of living outside metropolitan Melbourne.
And when you want the city, Melbourne is approximately around a two-hour drive, making weekends in the city, major events and international travel easily accessible.

The Role
This is a senior medical leadership position with genuine influence across clinical services, workforce development, education and specialist training.
As Clinical Director – Geriatric, Rehabilitation & Palliative Care Medicine, you will provide clinical management, medical leadership and strategic direction across Geriatric Medicine, Rehabilitation Medicine and Palliative Care services.

Working closely with the Chief Medical Officer, senior executive leadership, Medical Workforce and fellow Clinical Directors, you will help shape service delivery, workforce planning, clinical governance and the ongoing development of the directorate.

A particularly attractive aspect of the position is its strong education and training portfolio. You will oversee medical education for Monash University medical students within the relevant clinical stream and hold responsibility as Director of Training for the Victorian Geriatric Medicine Training Program.

It is an excellent opportunity for an established Specialist looking to move into a more influential medical leadership position while remaining clinically active, with the added opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to the development of the next generation of doctors and specialists.

The Hospital
This is a substantial regional referral and teaching health service with a strong reputation for clinical excellence, education, training and professional development.
You’ll work alongside Geriatricians, Rehabilitation Physicians, Palliative Care Physicians, registrars, junior medical staff and an extensive multidisciplinary allied health workforce.

The broader service incorporates comprehensive medical, surgical, rehabilitation, community and clinical support services, including Medical Imaging, Pharmacy and Pathology.
For specialists seeking leadership progression, this provides an opportunity to take on an influential role within a health service large enough to offer complexity, infrastructure and career development, while retaining the accessibility and collegiality of regional practice.

The Lifestyle
One of the biggest attractions is what happens outside the hospital.
You can enjoy the benefits of living in one of Victoria’s major regional centres, with excellent schools, restaurants, cafés, wineries, sporting facilities, parks, walking and cycling trails, shopping and cultural attractions.
Compared with metropolitan living, there is the potential for shorter commutes, greater housing choice and more time outside work, while Melbourne remains close enough for regular weekends away.

It’s an excellent option for specialists wanting to step up professionally without sacrificing lifestyle.

What We’re Looking For
We are interested in hearing from experienced Medical Specialists who can demonstrate:
  • Fellowship of an applicable specialist medical college, or equivalent
  • Full unconditional specialist registration with AHPRA
  • Significant senior-level clinical experience
  • Medical leadership and service management experience
  • An understanding of clinical governance, workforce, funding and budgets
  • The ability to lead and develop multidisciplinary clinical services
  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills
If you’re an experienced Specialist considering your next leadership move, this is an opportunity to combine executive-level influence, continued clinical practice and an enviable lifestyle within one of Victoria’s leading regional health services.

Ready for Your Next Leadership Opportunity?
If this opportunity aligns with your experience and leadership aspirations, we would be pleased to hear from you. Please submit your current CV or contact Nicki Wade for a friendly and confidential discussion.

Nicki Wade
Senior Recruitment Consultant – Permanent Doctors
CC Medical
Phone: +61 401 010 048
Email: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au

job.title: Specialist / Senior Specialist – Geriatrician
job.description:
Specialist / Senior Specialist – Geriatrician
Permanent full-time or part-time | Package up to $564,548 p.a.
Coastal lifestyle | Private practice potential | Flexible hours
A specialist career with more life outside work

Imagine finishing your working day and being only minutes from calm beaches, waterfront cafés, walking paths and a vibrant marina.
This is an opportunity to develop your career in Geriatric Medicine while enjoying shorter commutes, affordable housing, a mild year-round climate and significantly more time for family, recreation and life outside work.
Several permanent full-time and part-time positions are available within a supportive regional health service. Hours are negotiable, offering genuine flexibility to suit your professional and personal priorities.

The lifestyle
This opportunity is based in one of Australia’s most attractive coastal regions, offering:
  • Beautiful, family-friendly beaches and a relaxed waterfront lifestyle
  • A warm, mild climate suited to year-round outdoor living
  • Short commutes and less time spent in traffic
  • More affordable housing than major metropolitan centres
  • Waterfront cafés, restaurants, parks, walking paths and a lively marina
  • Easy access to World Heritage-listed islands and national parks
  • Exceptional fishing, boating, whale watching and water-based activities
  • Established schools, healthcare services and welcoming communities
  • Convenient air connections to a major capital city
The opportunity
You will join a collaborative multidisciplinary Internal Medicine team delivering specialist geriatric and rehabilitation services to a growing older population.
The role offers the opportunity to:
  • Provide expert assessment and management for older patients with complex medical, cognitive and functional needs
  • Work across acute, subacute and rehabilitation services
  • Collaborate with physicians, nursing, allied health and community-based teams
  • Support safe transitions between hospital, rehabilitation, residential and community care
  • Contribute to clinical leadership, governance and service development
  • Supervise, educate and mentor junior medical staff
  • Participate in undergraduate and postgraduate medical education
  • Help shape services in response to the needs of a growing regional community
Remuneration and benefits
A competitive remuneration package valued at up to $564,548 per annum is available, including:
  • Base salary of $223,136–$282,912 per annum
  • Employer superannuation contributions of up to 12.75%
  • 17.5% annual leave loading
  • Motor vehicle allowance
  • Professional development allowance
  • Paid professional development leave
  • Salary packaging options
  • Flexible rostering and work arrangements
  • Permanent full-time or part-time employment
  • Potential relocation and onboarding assistance
Private practice potential
The successful candidate may also have the opportunity to establish a private practice outside their public hospital appointment.

Potential assistance may include:
  • Access to sessional consulting rooms
  • Credentialling and administrative support
  • Assistance establishing local referral pathways
  • Introductions to GPs, physicians and surgeons
It is an ideal setting for specialists seeking meaningful clinical work without sacrificing lifestyle, family time or professional development.

About you
To be considered, you will hold or be eligible for:
  • Specialist registration in Geriatric Medicine with Ahpra
  • Fellowship of the Royal Australasian College of Physicians, or a recognised equivalent specialist qualification
  • Appropriate training and experience in Geriatric Medicine
Applications are encouraged from Australian and New Zealand-trained specialists, as well as suitably qualified internationally trained geriatricians eligible to pursue specialist registration in Australia.

Apply
If you are considering a permanent career move and would like to combine a rewarding specialist position with an exceptional coastal lifestyle, please apply with your current CV.
For a confidential discussion, please contact:

Nicki Wade
Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant
CC Medical

Phone: +61 401 010 048

job.title: Deputy Chief Medical Officer / Director Medical Services
job.description:
Deputy Chief Medical Officer / Director Medical Services
Permanent Full-Time | Executive Medical Leadership
Tropical Coastal Queensland | 90-Minute Direct Flight to Brisbane
Attractive Salary Package up to $500k
  • Shape medical workforce strategy, governance and clinical service development
  • Join a major regional health service during an important period of growth
  • Enjoy an exceptional coastal lifestyle with direct flights to Brisbane
An outstanding opportunity is available for an experienced medical leader to join a major regional Queensland health service as Deputy Chief Medical Officer / Director Medical Services.

Reporting directly to the Chief Medical Officer / Executive Director Medical Services, this is an influential executive position with responsibility for medical workforce strategy, education, credentialing, clinical governance and professional medical leadership.

Lifestyle
The position is based in a diverse, welcoming and fast-growing tropical coastal community offering an enviable balance of professional opportunity and lifestyle.

The region offers:
  • Coastal, island and rural lifestyle options
  • Beautiful beaches, national parks and easy access to nearby islands
  • A warm year-round climate ideal for outdoor living
  • Affordable housing and family-friendly communities
  • Excellent schools and comprehensive local amenities
  • Short commutes and a more manageable pace of life
  • A regional airport with direct flights to Brisbane taking approximately 90 minutes
The Opportunity
You will provide strategic and operational leadership across:
  • Medical workforce planning, recruitment, retention and service delivery
  • Medical education and prevocational medical training
  • Credentialing and scope-of-clinical-practice governance
  • Clinical governance, quality improvement and patient safety
  • Strategic planning and development of clinical services
  • Professional standards, ethical practice and medical workforce performance
  • Sustainable workforce strategies for regional, rural and remote services
The position leads the Medical Workforce, Medical Education and Credentialing functions and is supported by an established multidisciplinary leadership team.

As part of the health service’s senior leadership structure, you will work closely with clinical directors, operational leaders, executives and external stakeholders to strengthen medical governance and support the delivery of safe, sustainable and high-quality patient care.

About the Health Service
This major regional health service is one of the area’s largest employers and delivers acute, specialist and community-based care through an extensive network of hospitals and health facilities.

The principal hospital is a modern, redeveloped and fully digital regional referral centre equipped with contemporary clinical technology. It was Queensland’s first regional hospital to implement a fully integrated electronic medical record.

With continued population growth and significant future service development planned, this is an excellent time to join the organisation and help shape the next stage of its medical workforce and clinical service strategy.

About You
You will be an experienced, credible and collaborative medical leader who can demonstrate:
  • Leadership of complex medical workforce, education and credentialing functions
  • Experience providing high-quality strategic and executive-level advice
  • Strong clinical governance, patient safety and continuous-improvement expertise
  • The ability to build trusted relationships across clinical, operational, executive and external stakeholder environments
  • A sound understanding of regional and rural medical workforce challenges
  • Experience developing practical and sustainable workforce strategies
  • A strong commitment to professionalism, integrity and ethical practice
Essential Requirements
Applicants must hold:
  • A medical degree recognised by AHPRA for registration as a medical practitioner in Australia
  • Current or eligibility for medical registration with AHPRA
  • Fellowship of the Royal Australasian College of Medical Administrators (RACMA), significant progress towards Fellowship, or substantial senior medical-administration experience assessed as equivalent
  • Recent clinical practice relevant to the responsibilities of the position and consistent with Medical Board of Australia registration standards
  • The ability to obtain and maintain the credentialing and Scope of Clinical Practice required for the role
Applicants who have not completed RACMA Fellowship must demonstrate an ongoing commitment to appropriate continuing professional development in medical administration.

This is a career-defining opportunity to influence the medical workforce, governance and strategic direction of a major regional health service while enjoying one of Queensland’s most attractive tropical coastal lifestyles.

Interested in This Opportunity?
If this opportunity aligns with your medical leadership experience and career goals, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Whether you are actively considering your next executive leadership position or would simply like to learn more, please submit your current CV or contact Nicki Wade for a friendly and confidential discussion.

Know an experienced medical leader who may be interested? Please feel free to share this opportunity with a colleague in your network.

Nicki Wade
Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant
Ph: +61 401 010 048
Email: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au

job.description:
Consultant/Specialist Anaesthetist – Permanent Full-Time or Part-Time
Coastal Victoria | Within Easy Reach of Melbourne | Flexible Employment Fractions

An exciting permanent opportunity is available for a Anaesthetist to join a progressive and highly regarded anaesthesia department in coastal Victoria.
Offering the professional scope of a major health service alongside an enviable coastal lifestyle, this location provides the ideal balance of career opportunity, affordability and family living all within convenient reach of Melbourne.

The department comprises Staff Specialists, Visiting Consultants, Provisional Fellows and Registrars, delivering comprehensive services across anaesthesia, perioperative medicine and acute pain management.

Lifestyle
Enjoy the benefits of living in a vibrant coastal region offering:
  • Beautiful beaches and an active outdoor lifestyle
  • Excellent schools, healthcare services and family amenities
  • A thriving restaurant, café and cultural scene
  • Easy access to wineries, coastal villages and internationally renowned attractions
  • More space and greater housing affordability than metropolitan living
  • Convenient access to Melbourne for work, travel and entertainment
The opportunity
You will provide safe, patient-centred and evidence-based specialist care while contributing to the ongoing development of contemporary anaesthetic and perioperative services.
Both permanent full-time and part-time appointments are available, with flexibility across various employment fractions.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Delivering high-quality anaesthetic, perioperative and acute pain services
  • Working collaboratively within a multidisciplinary clinical team
  • Participating in undergraduate and postgraduate teaching and supervision
  • Contributing to clinical research, audit and quality-improvement activities
  • Supporting innovation and the development of services and models of care
  • Participating in the after-hours on-call and recall roster
  • Contributing specialist expertise while maintaining a broad clinical workload
Subspecialty interests are encouraged. Experience in perioperative medicine or cardiac anaesthesia would be particularly valued.

About you
To be considered, you will have:
  • A recognised medical degree
  • Fellowship of the Australian and New Zealand College of Anaesthetists or eligibility for specialist registration as an anaesthetist with AHPRA
  • A strong commitment to safe, patient-centred clinical care
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • The ability to work effectively within a complex and evolving multidisciplinary environment
  • An interest in teaching, research, clinical governance and service improvement
  • A professional, collaborative and team-focused approach
Remuneration and benefits
An attractive remuneration package and employment conditions are available under the applicable certified agreement. After-hours on-call and recall duties are remunerated in addition to the base salary.
Specialist international medical graduates who are eligible for specialist registration in Australia are encouraged to enquire. Must be ANZCA assessed as substantially comparable or eligible via expedited pathway.

Interested in This Opportunity?
If this opportunity aligns with your experience and career goals, we would be delighted to hear from you.
Whether you are actively considering your next career move or would simply like to learn more, please submit your current CV or contact Nicki Wade for a friendly and confidential discussion.

Know an Anaesthetist who may be interested? Please feel free to share this opportunity with a colleague in your network.

Nicki Wade
Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant
Ph: +61 401 010 048
Email: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au
With over 30 years of recruitment expertise, CC Medical (formerly known as Careers Connection)

job.title: Consultant/Specialist Anaesthetist | Regional Victoria
job.description:
Consultant/Specialist Anaesthetist | Regional Victoria
Flexible Full-Time Opportunities
Exceptional Lifestyle | Regional Victoria | Easy Access to Major Centres

Looking for a Consultant Anaesthetics role that offers professional variety without compromising your lifestyle?
We are recruiting for an experienced Consultant Anaesthetist to join a supportive regional health service offering flexible full-time or sessional appointments, an attractive remuneration package and on-call allowances.

This is an opportunity to enjoy the best of regional Victorian living while remaining well connected to major centres.
Think more space, less traffic, shorter commutes and more time outside of work. The region offers an outstanding outdoor lifestyle with national parks, hiking, cycling, wineries, great food and welcoming regional communities all within easy reach.

You won't feel isolated. Melbourne is accessible for weekends away and city connections, while major regional centres are within comfortable driving distance, providing access to additional shopping, dining, schools, sporting facilities and services.
For those wanting to escape the cost and congestion of metropolitan living without giving up accessibility, this offers an appealing balance of career, lifestyle and connectivity.
The Opportunity
  • Flexible full-time or sessional appointments
  • Attractive Consultant remuneration plus on-call allowances
  • Broad and varied Anaesthetics practice
  • Work within an established and supportive multidisciplinary team
  • Opportunities to work across a wider regional health network
  • Genuine opportunity to influence and strengthen regional service delivery
  • Excellent work-life balance
The Lifestyle
This is an opportunity to enjoy the best of regional Victorian living while remaining well connected to major centres.

The Role
This is a varied Consultant Anaesthetics position offering exposure across a broad range of clinical presentations and surgical specialties.
You will:
  • Provide high-quality anaesthetic care across adult, paediatric and obstetric patients
  • Manage a diverse range of elective and emergency surgical cases
  • Participate in clinical research and quality improvement initiatives
  • Contribute to the ongoing review and development of clinical practice
  • Work collaboratively within an experienced multidisciplinary team
  • Contribute to the delivery and ongoing development of regional anaesthetic services
About You
We would welcome applications from:
  • FANZCA-qualified Consultant Anaesthetists
  • Specialists eligible for registration with the Medical Board of Australia/AHPRA
  • Rural Generalist Anaesthetists with appropriate qualifications and experience
  • Internationally trained Anaesthetists with comparable specialist qualifications who may be eligible to pursue specialist recognition in Australia
Ideally, you will bring:
  • Experience providing anaesthetic services across a broad range of surgical specialties
  • Confidence managing adult, paediatric and obstetric anaesthesia
  • Previous regional or rural experience, although this is not essential for the right candidate
  • Experience in thoracic and vascular anaesthesia would be highly regarded
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • A collaborative approach and ability to establish effective working relationships across multidisciplinary teams
Interested?
If you would like to explore this opportunity further, we would be pleased to hear from you.
For further information or a confidential discussion, please Contact Nicki Wade | Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant | CC Medical
Confidential enquiries welcome.

job.title: Locum Hospital Physiotherapist or Exercise Physiologist
job.description:
• 31st August – 6th November
  • Locum rates, travel and accommodation
  • Coastal VIC location

 
 
Locum Hospital Physiotherapist OR Exercise Physiologist required for this coastal service. The role is full time, 76 hours per fortnight. This is a Grade 2 level role, also open to experienced Grade 1 clinicians ready to take the next step. You will cover a caseload, as well as providing supervision and support to junior clinicians. 31st August – 6th November.
 

The division of Primary Care Services offer a range of community-based prevention, early intervention, post-acute treatment, health rehabilitation and recovery and continuing services designed to improve or maintain the health of individuals and communities. The Allied Health department comprises of 11 different specialty services providing services to clients in the Shire.

 
This position is a generalist physiotherapy or exercise physiology caseload that involves treating a diverse range of conditions across various patient demographics. Working with a multidisciplinary allied Health team, clinicians applying for this position must have sounds understanding across the following areas:
 
  • Inpatient general medical & orthopaedic caseload
  • Community outpatient clinics
  • Rehab groups, Ortho and Falls & Balance
  • Residential aged care, initial assessment and review
  • Working with and delegating task to Allied Health Assistants
 

This role requires adaptability and broad expertise to deliver personalise care in different clinical settings. This role may require the clinician to work in a sole practitioner on occasion.
  • Monday-Friday, full time
  • Up to 76 hours per fortnight
  • FREE accommodation or accommodation allowance
  • Locum rates depending on experience. Option for living away from home tax benefits – more take home pay upto $6 per hour extra
  • $200 towards travel
  • Current valid ‘C’ class Victorian driver’s licence required
 
 
 
Enjoy coastal living and weekend trips along the Great Ocean Road, as well as range of water sports, national parks and outdoor adventures.

 
To apply for this role or to enquire about our other vacancies, please contact Rachael – Allied Health Division Lead at CC Medical on 0452 189 556 or email rachaeld@ccjobs.com.au

 
My contactable days are Monday – Friday. If you need to contact me over the weekend, please send an email.
 
 
Register today for information on all of our vacancies.
 
View all our vacancies here: www.ccjobs.com.au

job.title: Locum Podiatrist needed across AUS
job.description:
Experienced Podiatrists required for locums across Australia - please see a small sample of the current vacancies below:

Coastal South Australia - Locum Podiatrist/Senior Podiatrist
  • August/September start for 12 weeks ++
  • Outpatients, high risk feet, complex wound care
  • Locum rates & FREE accommodation + travel
Experienced Podiatrists required for role with regional health service, located approximately seven hours drive from Adelaide (there is also an airport in town). You’ll join a medium size allied health team. The role is to start ASAP. 12 weeks ++ in duration.
 
 
Your caseload will cover:
  • Rural generalist caseload. Caseload is predominately outpatients, but includes some inpatients, aged care and paediatrics. May be opportunities for outreach to rural/ remote communities. Caseload would be allocated as per experience.
  • You will be proficient in high risk wound care but would be working in a rural generalist role servicing clients across the age spectrum and across clinical priorities and programs.
  • Regional/ rural experience preferred - working with Aboriginal consumers, high risk wound experience.
  • Sunrise experience preferred for clinical documentation needs
  • You will be working in the local community. A car is provided for work purposes. The role will be Monday – Friday, 37.5 hours per week.
  • Free accommodation provided
  • Competitive locum rates in line with experience – PAYG + option for living away from home tax benefits or ABN (up to $100 per hour)
 
The Eyre and Far North covers almost 440,000 square kilometres of spectacular South Australia, supporting about 40,000 people living around Eyre Peninsula and the Far North of the state.
 
With its ancient outback landscapes and culture, boutique vineyards, renowned oyster farms and Australia’s best-kept-secret surf coast, the Eyre Peninsula and Far North offers a lifestyle that will inspire and energise you. The region enjoys a Mediterranean style climate so there’s plenty of opportunity to enjoy everything the region has to offer. From surfing and fishing to hiking and exploring the outback – create your best life, right here.
 
 
 
 
 
Townsville, sunny QLD - Locum Podiatrist
  • ASAP start for 4-12 weeks + possible extension
  • Locum rates $$ + car provided
  • Community and outreach
Locum Podiatrist required for a role in sunny Townsville. I’ve had great feedback from other locums. You will join a team of allied health clinicians.
  • The caseload is generalist position covering outreach communities of Charters Towers, Collinsville, Bowen, Ayr/Home Hill, Ingham
  • Predominantly working with community-based aged care clients- no nursing homes; diabetes foot assessments, primary care
  • Monday – Friday. The hours are flexible to account for time spent travelling to outreach sites.
  • No accommodation available
  • All travel amongst sites covered using fleet cars
 
Additional Information:
  • August/September for 4-12 weeks + longer term options also available.
  • Locum rates based on experience, more for ABN!
  • Potential for PAYG living away from home benefits (more take home pay, usually $5-7 dollars more an hour!).
  • A car is provided for work travel between sites.
 
Escape winter in sunny Townsville. Enjoy a tropical climate, thriving water sports scene including diving, snorkelling, boating, fishing, kayaking. Explore the neighbouring islands and Great Barrier Reef, enjoy endless sunshine, national parks, hikes and waterfalls and a bustling city centre.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Remote QLD - 2 x Locum Podiatrist – remote health and outreach
  • ASAP start for 8-12 weeks + possible extension
  • Locum rates $$ + accommodation and travel provided
  • Community and outreach
2 x Locum Podiatrists required for locum roles in Outback Queensland. I’ve had great feedback from other locums. You will join a team of allied health clinicians and cover:
  • Initial assessments and reviews
  • Diabetic foot assessments
  • General nail care and treatment
  • Biomechanical and orthotics
  • A generalist caseload predominantly for low to moderate risk clients
  • Outreach involving road and sometimes aircraft with overnight travel. The multidisciplinary team provides outreach to communities in the area
  • Indigenous and Torres Strait Islander population as well as general population
  • Monday – Friday. The hours are flexible to account for time spent travelling to outreach sites.
  • There are two locations available.
 
Additional Information:
  • August/September for 8-12 weeks + longer term options also available.
  • Locum rates based on experience, more for ABN.
  • Potential for PAYG living away from home benefits (more take home pay, usually $5-7 dollars more an hour!).
  • FREE accommodation, a private room in a share house. There may or may not be other occupants depending on timing. A car is also provided for local use.
  • Return flights reimbursed.
Are you ready to experience Outback Australia?
 
 
 
 
 
 
Regional SA - Locum Podiatrist/Senior Podiatrist 
  • August/September start for three months ++
  • Outpatients, high risk feet, complex wound care
  • Locum rates & FREE accommodation + travel
Experienced Podiatrists required for role with regional health service, located approximately four hours from Adelaide. You’ll join a medium size allied health team. The role is to start ASAP. Three months ++ in duration.
 
There are several vacancies across two locations. Open to AHP 1, 2 or 3 level options.
 
Your caseload will cover:
  • Rural generalist caseload. Caseload is predominately outpatients, but includes some inpatients, aged care and paediatrics. May be opportunities for outreach to rural/ remote communities. Caseload would be allocated as per experience.
  • You will be will be proficient in high risk wound care (with 30-40 active high-risk wound patients at the site) but would be working in a rural generalist role servicing clients across the age spectrum and across clinical priorities and programs.
  • Regional/ rural experience preferred - working with Aboriginal consumers, high risk wound experience.
  • Join a multi-disciplinary team including OT, PT, SP, SW, O&P, DT. The Podiatrists work closely with Diabetes Educators, Orthotics & Prosthetics and Wound Nurse. The Podiatry department will soon consistent of 3 contractor/ FIFO staff.
  • You will be working in the local community. A car is provided for work purposes. The role will be Monday – Friday, 37.5 hours per week.
  • Free accommodation provided
  • Upto $500 reimbursed for travel (with receipts)
  • Competitive locum rates in line with experience – PAYG + option for living away from home tax benefits or ABN (up to $100 per hour)
 
I’ve placed many locums with this service over the years and the feedback is positive. The team are young and inclusive.
 
 
Located on Eyre Peninsula’s Spencer Gulf in South Australia, this region is an important hub and the region’s biggest city for retail shopping. The location boasts a warm climate, accessible ocean shores and saltwater fishing. It represents South Australia’s foremost combination of industrial and nature-based experiences. With vivid scenery, small city charm, distinctive mystic outback landscapes and year-round things to do.
 
 
 
 
 
Regional VIC - Podiatrist – regional health service
  • Rural Generalist inc:  outpatients & community
  • Travel + accommodation available
  • Locum rates up to $80 PAYG/$100 ABN
Experienced Podiatrist required for locum based in regional Victoria. The role is to start 31st August, flexible duration for locums - minimum 8 weeks required.
 
You will work alongside a small allied health team. This generalist caseload will cover:
  • A mixed caseload of clients from 0-100 years
  • Working across outpatients, community, a small amount of aged care & outreach
  • You will work alongside a team of other allied health professionals on the team including OT, Physiotherapist, Exercise Physiologist, Speech Pathologists, Dietitian, Qualified Social Worker, Health Promotion Officer and Allied Health Assistants
 
FREE accommodation available and locum rates up to $80 + super PAYG/$100 ABN. Travel reimbursement also available.
 
I’ve had great feedback from previous locums! There is also a permanent opportunity available. Minimum one year experience required.
 
Working in regional Australia offers the chance to work within close knit communities. As part of smaller teams, you will access a wider range of patients and develop your clinical expertise. These roles offer great rates of pay, accommodation and the chance to broaden your skill set within a range of healthcare settings.
 
 
 
 
 
Gorgeous regional VIC location - Podiatrist - 6-12 month contract
  • 2.5 hours from Melbourne
  • 6-12 months in duration
Join this lovely regional health service based in Victoria, just two and a half hours from Melbourne. A great team, my other candidates have loved this service. 
 
The role involves the provision of podiatry services to clients across the service areas, including community outpatients, acute, subacute, residential aged care and outreach services. The role focuses on providing appropriate services in the right setting, increasing the knowledge and skills of individuals in the community around foot health and mobility, delivery safe and comprehensive podiatric services to our high-risk clients and encourage where appropriate individuals to self-manage their own foot health while promoting health and wellbeing for all clients. Fixed term contract. No accommodation available
 
Join this lovely regional tourism hot spot based in Victoria, just two and a half from Melbourne. A great team, my other candidates have loved this service.
 
 

 

 
 
Working in regional Australia offers the chance to work within close knit communities. As part of smaller teams, you will access a wider range of patients and develop your clinical expertise. These roles offer great rates of pay, accommodation and the chance to broaden your skill set within a range of healthcare settings.



To apply for this role or to enquire about our other vacancies, please contact Rachael – Allied Health Division Lead at CC Medical on 0452 189 556 or email rachaeld@ccjobs.com.au



My contactable days are Monday – Friday. If you need to contact me over the weekend, please send an email.

job.title: Locum Hospital Speech Pathologist/Senior Speech Pathologist
job.description:
• 7th September for approx. one month
  • Upto $80 per hour + tax benefits – upto $8 extra per hour!
  • Accommodation + travel

 
 
Experienced Speech Pathologist required for a hospital based in North Queensland. You will work alongside a multidisciplinary team of allied health staff.
  • Hours would be 0800-1630 Monday to Friday with 1 hour unpaid break (7.5 hours per day)
  • Working across a rural generalist caseload including inpatient and outpatient caseloads across the lifespan, paediatrics to adults.
  • Working amongst the multidisciplinary team which is young and dynamic. The team regularly plan weekend adventures including camping, rodeos, and local events like wine festivals, balls, markets, and sporting events. We even hold an Allied Health Ball every year to celebrate all Allied Health Clinicians in North West Queensland. We have a few gyms in town including a yoga studio, Anytime Fitness, Pilates studio, a public pool and plenty of outdoor walking areas. There are cafes, a library, Kmart, Woolies and Coles, Harvey Norman, and a couple of specialty stores. The area is surrounded by cattle stations and you can even feed some camels just down the road from the Hospital! There’s a large freshwater lake 10km out of town where people regularly paddleboard, water ski, swim, and kayak to get their water fix, and there’s lots of water holes/water falls that can be visited after wet season to keep cool.
  • There are daily flights to Brisbane and Townsville and some direct flights throughout the week to Cairns.
    The rural and remote lifestyle often has some surprising perks and the opportunities both professionally and personally are great.
  • Locum rates upto $80 per hour + super + option for living away from home tax benefits – more take home pay upto $8 per hour
  • Accommodation can be provided for the length of contract
  • Up to $1000 (incl. GST) will be reimbursed for one way travel
 
 
You must be an experienced Speech Pathologist with the relevant skill set. A minimum of three years relevant experience is required.


This region offers a real insight into Outback Australia, with a wide range of places to enjoy 4 wheel driving, camping, fishing and hiking. A great location for any intrepid explorer!
