job.title: Consultant/Specialist Paediatrician
job.description:
Consultant/Specialist Paediatrician
Live and Work in Tropical Northern Australia
  • Remuneration package up to $420K+
  • Substantially comparable SIMGs considered
  • Expedited Specialist Pathway applicants welcomed
  • Exceptional clinical variety, teaching and remote outreach
An exciting opportunity is available for a Consultant Paediatrician to join a supportive and highly experienced Women’s, Children and Youth team at a leading tertiary hospital in tropical Northern Australia.

LIFESTYLE LIKE NOWHERE ELSE
Enjoy a tropical outdoor lifestyle with warm weather, spectacular sunsets and more time for life outside work.
  • No long commutes
  • Excellent fishing, boating and outdoor activities
  • Easy access to Kakadu and Litchfield national parks
  • A welcoming, close-knit medical community
  • Diverse cultural, dining and community experiences
  • An ideal base from which to explore northern Australia and Southeast Asia
This is an opportunity to combine meaningful specialist practice and career development with an adventurous lifestyle and genuine work-life balance.

REMUNERATION AND SUPPORT
  • Remuneration package up to $420K+
  • Relocation assistance may be available
  • Employer-sponsored visa support for eligible applicants
  • Guidance with specialist assessment, AHPRA registration and immigration processes
This position offers exposure to one of Australia’s most varied and rewarding general paediatric practices, providing specialist care across tertiary, regional and remote health services.

THE OPPORTUNITY
You will manage a broad and clinically stimulating caseload across acute, general, developmental and behavioural paediatrics.
The service provides:
  • General paediatric and adolescent inpatient care
  • Neonatal intensive care and retrieval services
  • General and specialist outpatient clinics
  • Outreach services to regional hospitals and remote communities
  • Care for children and families from culturally diverse backgrounds
  • Teaching and supervision of paediatric trainees, junior doctors and medical students
Clinical presentations range from common childhood illnesses to complex conditions more prevalent across tropical, rural and remote communities, including bronchiectasis, rheumatic heart disease, malnutrition and infectious diseases.
You will also contribute to clinical governance, service development, research, quality improvement and postgraduate education.

ABOUT YOU
To be considered, you will have:
  • FRACP in Paediatrics and specialist registration with AHPRA; or
  • An overseas specialist qualification assessed as substantially comparable; or
  • Eligibility to apply through Australia’s Expedited Specialist Pathway
  • Experience in acute and general paediatrics
  • Strong communication, teamwork and clinical leadership skills

• August/September start for 12 weeks ++
  • Outpatients, high risk feet, complex wound care
  • Locum rates & FREE accommodation 

 
Experienced Podiatrist required for role with regional health service, located approximately seven hours drive from Adelaide (there is an airport in town). You’ll join a medium size allied health team. The role is to start ASAP. 12 weeks  ++ in duration.
 
 
Your caseload will cover:
  • Rural generalist caseload. Caseload is predominately outpatients, but includes some inpatients, aged care and paediatrics. May be opportunities for outreach to rural/ remote communities. Caseload would be allocated as per experience.
  • You will be proficient in high risk wound care but would be working in a rural generalist role servicing clients across the age spectrum and across clinical priorities and programs.
  • Regional/ rural experience preferred - working with Aboriginal consumers, high risk wound experience.
  • Sunrise experience preferred for clinical documentation needs
  • You will be working in the local community. A car is provided for work purposes. The role will be Monday – Friday, 37.5 hours per week.
  • Free accommodation provided
  • Competitive locum rates in line with experience – PAYG + option for living away from home tax benefits or ABN (up to $100 per hour)
 
 
 
The Eyre and Far North covers almost 440,000 square kilometres of spectacular South Australia, supporting about 40,000 people living around Eyre Peninsula and the Far North of the state.


With its ancient outback landscapes and culture, boutique vineyards, renowned oyster farms and Australia’s best-kept-secret surf coast, the Eyre Peninsula and Far North offers a lifestyle that will inspire and energise you. The region enjoys a Mediterranean style climate so there’s plenty of opportunity to enjoy everything the region has to offer. From surfing and fishing to hiking and exploring the outback – create your best life, right here.

job.title: Locum Senior Hospital Dietitian
job.description:
• 7th September for 8 weeks
  • Accommodation available + travel assistance
  • Upto $80 per hour + super + tax benefits
  • Living away from home tax benefits – upto $8 extra per hour!

 
Experienced Dietitian required for hospital based role in the Northern Territory. You will join team of 100 allied health clinicians, including Occupational Therapists, Podiatrists, Physiotherapists, Speech Pathologists, Dietitians, Social Workers, Chaplain, ALO. I’ve had great feedback from my current locums.
 
  • 7th September for 8 weeks
  • Acute care or renal experience required
  • The caseload is acute care- ICU, paediatrics, renal, surgical general medical and outpatients, gastro- including PEG and IBD. A lot of opportunities for unique experiences and professional development including eating disorders, motivational interviewing and cultural engagement.
  • Team leadership experience preferred
  • Locum rates upto $80 per hour + super
  • Option for living away from home tax benefits – more take home pay upto $8 per hour
  • ABN payment also an option!
  • Hospital experience is mandatory
  • You need to have or be eligible for Accredited Practising Dietitian (APD) status.
  • Work hours are 8am to 4.21pm
  • Driver’s licence is preferred but not essential.
  • Opportunity for remote trips if desired
  • The team is very social.
  • Relocation assistance of upto $1000 and subsidised accommodation available. The accommodation is on site, so less than 5 min to walk to work and 10 minutes to town.

Join this large allied health team, including some of my other locums. All have extended their time with this hospital. The team are inclusive and social.

85% of the caseload is indigenous, with 50% coming in from remote communities. I’ve had great feedback from my current locums and this is a great chance to develop your skill set. If you like the outdoors, the lifestyle here is fab! 

The location is a great base for exploring the natural wonders of the Outback including: Uluru, Kata Tjuta, Kings Canyon, the West MacDonnell Ranges and the Larapinta Trail, the Simpson Desert and the gorgeous NT watering holes. It’s also a fascinating spot to explore Australia’s Aboriginal culture.

Working in regional Australia offers the chance to work within close knit communities. As part of smaller teams, you will access a wider range of patients and develop your clinical expertise. These roles offer great rates of pay, accommodation and the chance to broaden your skill set within a range of healthcare settings.

job.title: Consultant Obstetrician & Gynaecologist – Coastal Tasmania
job.description:
Consultant Obstetrician & Gynaecologist – Coastal Tasmania
Permanent Full-Time | Salary Package up to $647,306 | Exceptional Coastal Lifestyle
An outstanding opportunity is available for an experienced Consultant Obstetrician & Gynaecologist to join a highly regarded regional health service in coastal Tasmania.
Offering an exceptional remuneration package, broad clinical scope and genuine work–life balance, this role provides the opportunity to deliver high-quality specialist care while enjoying one of Australia’s most desirable coastal lifestyles.

The Opportunity
This permanent full-time appointment offers the opportunity to work within a comprehensive regional Obstetrics and Gynaecology service, providing specialist care across inpatient, outpatient and procedural settings.
The position is available for up to 76 hours per fortnight, with working arrangements open to negotiation.
You will join a supportive multidisciplinary team and contribute to clinical education, service development and improving healthcare outcomes across the region.

The Department
The Obstetrics and Gynaecology Department provides comprehensive regional services supported by:
  • Approximately 1,000 births annually
  • Level 4 maternity and neonatal services
  • Eight-bed Intensive Care Unit
  • Experienced midwives and a highly regarded Midwifery Group Practice
  • Antenatal and gynaecology outreach services
  • University-affiliated undergraduate and postgraduate teaching opportunities
  • Opportunities to influence service development and regional healthcare delivery
  • Supportive multidisciplinary and specialist teams
  • Typical after-hours roster of approximately 1:5 weekdays and weekends
Remuneration and Benefits
  • Total remuneration package up to $647,306
  • Indicative package range approximately $465,112–$647,306
  • 12% superannuation
  • 20% regional recruitment and retention allowance
  • 35% private practice scheme participation or allowance in lieu
  • Fully maintained private-plated vehicle or motor vehicle allowance of $28,786
  • Continuing Professional Development allowance of $17,483
  • Generous salary packaging benefits
  • Relocation and travel assistance
  • Study leave and professional development support
  • Comprehensive leave entitlements
The Location
Located in coastal Tasmania, this vibrant regional city offers an exceptional lifestyle surrounded by dramatic coastline, pristine beaches, mountains and national parks.
This is an opportunity to enjoy:
  • A more balanced lifestyle with shorter commute times
  • More attainable housing compared with major capital cities
  • Excellent schools, sporting facilities and welcoming communities
  • Easy access to walking trails, waterfalls, wineries, farmers’ markets and some of Australia’s most celebrated wilderness destinations
Despite its peaceful setting, the region remains well connected. The nearest airport is approximately 20 minutes from the hospital and offers direct flights to a major mainland capital in around 70 minutes. A second regional airport approximately 40 minutes away provides additional travel options.

About You
You will hold:
  • Current AHPRA specialist registration or limited registration
  • Fellowship of the relevant specialist college or equivalent qualifications
  • Demonstrated experience in Obstetrics and Gynaecology
  • Commitment to multidisciplinary care, teaching and service improvement
This is an exciting opportunity to develop a rewarding specialist career while enjoying the lifestyle benefits of coastal Tasmania.

How to Apply
For a confidential discussion or to apply, please contact:
Nicki Wade
Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant
 nickiw@ccjobs.com.au
+61401 010 048

job.title: Consultant Anaesthetist
job.description:
Consultant Anaesthetist
Permanent Part-Time (0.75 FTE) | Regional South Australia | Indicative Total Remuneration up to $756,662 p.a. (pro rata)
An exciting permanent opportunity is available for a Consultant Anaesthetist to join a well-established regional health service in South Australia.

This 0.75 FTE position offers a varied scope of contemporary anaesthetic practice across surgical, obstetric and critical care services, together with opportunities to contribute to teaching, clinical governance and service development.
A convenient regional airport offers regular direct flights to both Adelaide and Melbourne, making interstate travel and visits from family and friends easy.

The location is a thriving regional centre offering an excellent balance between professional opportunity and quality of life. It provides the amenities required for comfortable family living while retaining the affordability, space and sense of community that are increasingly difficult to find in larger cities.

For doctors relocating from the UK or a metropolitan centre, the region offers the space and lifestyle benefits of regional Australia without sacrificing essential services, education, recreation or connectivity.

Lifestyle advantages include:
  • More affordable housing, with opportunities for larger homes and land
  • Shorter commutes and more time outside work
  • A relaxed, welcoming and family-friendly community
  • Access to TAFE and university education
  • Quality cafés, restaurants and outstanding local produce
  • Internationally recognised wineries and food experiences
  • Beautiful coastline, safe beaches and recreational fishing
  • National parks, walking trails, caves and outdoor adventures
  • Strong sporting clubs, community groups and cultural activities
  • A convenient position between two major Australian capital cities
Applicants should hold:
  • FANZCA or an equivalent specialist qualification
  • Eligibility for Specialist Registration with AHPRA
Internationally trained anaesthetists who have been assessed as Substantially Comparable or meet the Expedited Specialist Pathway are also encouraged to enquire.
The department is led by a new Director with extensive UK and Australian experience, who is building an innovative, progressive and supportive team culture. This is an excellent opportunity to join the department at an exciting stage of its development and have genuine input into the future direction of the service.

Remuneration and benefits
A highly competitive remuneration package is available, including:
  • Permanent Part-Time (0.75 FTE) appointment working over a 7-day roster
  • Indicative total remuneration of up to $756,662 p.a. (pro rata)
  • Relocation reimbursement
  • Supportive and forward-thinking departmental leadership
  • Broad surgical and obstetric anaesthetic practice
  • Opportunities to influence service development and clinical practice
  • Teaching, mentoring, research and quality-improvement opportunities
  • A collaborative multidisciplinary working environment
  • An attractive regional lifestyle with considerably less commuting
Apply now
Take the next step in your career and join a progressive regional health service offering excellent clinical variety, professional development and an outstanding lifestyle.

For a confidential discussion or to apply, please contact:
Nicki Wade
Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant
CC Medical
+61 401 010 048
nickiw@ccjobs.com.au

If anyone you know is seeking a regional move with excellent earning potential, please share my contact details so we can discuss the opportunity further.
All enquiries will be treated confidentially.
job.salary: Indicative Total Remuneration up to $756,662 p.a. (pro rata)

job.title: Hospital Speech Pathologist / Senior Hospital Speech Pathologist
job.description:
• 6-12 month contract + possible extension
  • Travel and accommodation available
  • Annual salary up to $125,507 + superannuation
Experienced Speech Pathologist required for this role based in regional New South Wales. The role is based 4 hours from Sydney and 2 hours from Canberra. You will work alongside a multidisciplinary allied health team. There is a level 1 /2 role or a level 3 role available.
 
Minimum six month commitment required, open to longer term or permanent also.
 
This sole clinician, Rural Generalist role which supports inpatients and outpatients with acquired communication and swallowing impairments on background neurodegenerative conditions, acquired brain injury, head and neck cancer and other medical conditions. No paediatrics in the caseload.
  • Acquired communication disorders covers the range of speech, voice, language, and fluency disorders.
  • Acquired brain injury, stroke, neurological diagnosis, oncology and TBI.
 
Open to Level 1 or 2 & 3 clinicians. 
 
Annual salaries are:
  • Level 1 / 2 salary from $82,262 - $113,301 + superannuation
  • Level 3 from $121,568 - $125,507 + superannuation
 
Accommodation is available within walking distance to the hospital. Subsidised simple hospital accommodation (single room, shared kitchen and single sex bathroom) for $71 a week.
 
The location is a great rural town with lots of cultural, food and exercise/sport options and easy access amenities (cafes, Big W, 3 supermarkets). 2hrs from Canberra, 2hrs from Wagga, 2hrs from Orange. 
 
 
Join my other candidates!

 
Working in regional Australia offers the chance to work within close knit communities. As part of smaller teams, you will access a wider range of patients and develop your clinical expertise. These roles offer great rates of pay, accommodation and the chance to broaden your skill set within a range of healthcare settings.
 
 
To apply for this role or to enquire about our other vacancies, please contact Rachael – Allied Health Division Lead at CC Medical on 0452 189 556 or email rachaeld@ccjobs.com.au


My contactable days are Monday – Friday. If you need to contact me over the weekend, please send an email.
